===== FILE: app/static/js/kemet-ui.js =====
(function () {
    "use strict";

    function markActiveNavigation() {
        var current = window.location.pathname;

        document.querySelectorAll(".k-nav a[href]").forEach(function (link) {
            var href = link.getAttribute("href");

            if (!href || href === "#") {
                return;
            }

            if (
                current === href ||
                (href !== "/" && current.indexOf(href + "/") === 0)
            ) {
                link.classList.add("active");
            }
        });
    }

    function bindMobileMenu() {
        var button = document.querySelector("[data-kemet-menu]");
        var sidebar = document.querySelector(".k-sidebar");

        if (!button || !sidebar) {
            return;
        }

        button.addEventListener("click", function () {
            sidebar.style.width =
                sidebar.style.width === "250px" ? "0" : "250px";
            sidebar.style.padding =
                sidebar.style.width === "250px" ? "18px 12px" : "0";
        });
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        markActiveNavigation();
        bindMobileMenu();
    });
})();

(function () {
    function kemetV52ActiveNavigation() {
        var current = window.location.pathname;

        document.querySelectorAll(".k-v52-nav a").forEach(function (link) {
            var href = link.getAttribute("href");

            if (!href || href === "#") {
                return;
            }

            if (
                current === href ||
                (href !== "/" && current.indexOf(href + "/") === 0)
            ) {
                link.classList.add("active");
            }
        });
    }

    document.addEventListener(
        "DOMContentLoaded",
        kemetV52ActiveNavigation
    );
})();


===== FILE: app/static/js/kemet-v2.js =====
(function () {
    "use strict";

    function ready(fn) {
        if (document.readyState === "loading") {
            document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
        } else {
            fn();
        }
    }

    function toast(message, type) {
        if (!message) return;

        var container = document.querySelector(".kemet-v2-toast-container");

        if (!container) {
            container = document.createElement("div");
            container.className = "kemet-v2-toast-container";
            document.body.appendChild(container);
        }

        var item = document.createElement("div");
        item.className = "kemet-v2-toast " + (type || "info");
        item.textContent = message;

        container.appendChild(item);

        setTimeout(function () {
            item.style.opacity = "0";
            item.style.transform = "translateY(-6px)";
            setTimeout(function () {
                item.remove();
            }, 180);
        }, 3500);
    }

    function setupBackToTop() {
        var btn = document.createElement("button");
        btn.type = "button";
        btn.className = "kemet-v2-top";
        btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Back to top");
        btn.innerHTML = "↑";

        document.body.appendChild(btn);

        window.addEventListener("scroll", function () {
            if (window.scrollY > 350) {
                btn.classList.add("visible");
            } else {
                btn.classList.remove("visible");
            }
        }, { passive: true });

        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            window.scrollTo({
                top: 0,
                behavior: "smooth"
            });
        });
    }

    function setupForms() {
        document.querySelectorAll("form").forEach(function (form) {
            form.addEventListener("submit", function () {
                var submit = form.querySelector(
                    'button[type="submit"], input[type="submit"]'
                );

                if (!submit) return;

                if (submit.dataset.kemetBusy === "1") {
                    return;
                }

                submit.dataset.kemetBusy = "1";
                submit.classList.add("kemet-v2-loading");
            });
        });
    }

    function setupExternalLinks() {
        document.querySelectorAll("a[target='_blank']").forEach(function (a) {
            var rel = a.getAttribute("rel") || "";

            if (!rel.includes("noopener")) {
                a.setAttribute(
                    "rel",
                    (rel + " noopener noreferrer").trim()
                );
            }
        });
    }

    function removeLegacyYellowButtons() {
        document.querySelectorAll(
            ".btn-yellow, .yellow-button, .warning-yellow-button, .kemet-yellow-button"
        ).forEach(function (el) {
            el.remove();
        });

        document.querySelectorAll("button, a").forEach(function (el) {
            var text = (el.textContent || "").trim().toLowerCase();

            if (
                text === "yellow" ||
                text === "الزر الأصفر" ||
                text === "button yellow"
            ) {
                el.remove();
            }
        });
    }

    ready(function () {
        setupBackToTop();
        setupForms();
        setupExternalLinks();
        removeLegacyYellowButtons();

        window.KemetV2 = {
            toast: toast
        };
    });
})();

(function () {
    "use strict";

    function ready(fn) {
        if (document.readyState === "loading") {
            document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
        } else {
            fn();
        }
    }

    function toast(message, type) {
        if (!message) return;

        var container = document.querySelector(
            ".kemet-v3-toast-container"
        );

        if (!container) {
            container = document.createElement("div");
            container.className = "kemet-v3-toast-container";
            document.body.appendChild(container);
        }

        var item = document.createElement("div");

        item.className =
            "kemet-v3-toast " + (type || "info");

        item.textContent = message;

        container.appendChild(item);

        setTimeout(function () {
            item.style.opacity = "0";
            item.style.transform = "translateY(-6px)";

            setTimeout(function () {
                item.remove();
            }, 180);
        }, 3500);
    }

    function setupBackToTop() {
        var btn = document.createElement("button");

        btn.type = "button";
        btn.className = "kemet-v3-top";
        btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Back to top");
        btn.innerHTML = "↑";

        document.body.appendChild(btn);

        window.addEventListener(
            "scroll",
            function () {
                if (window.scrollY > 350) {
                    btn.classList.add("visible");
                } else {
                    btn.classList.remove("visible");
                }
            },
            { passive: true }
        );

        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            window.scrollTo({
                top: 0,
                behavior: "smooth"
            });
        });
    }

    function setupForms() {
        document.querySelectorAll("form").forEach(function (form) {
            form.addEventListener("submit", function () {
                var submit = form.querySelector(
                    'button[type="submit"], input[type="submit"]'
                );

                if (!submit) return;

                if (submit.dataset.kemetBusy === "1") {
                    return;
                }

                submit.dataset.kemetBusy = "1";
                submit.classList.add("kemet-v3-loading");
            });
        });
    }

    function secureExternalLinks() {
        document
            .querySelectorAll("a[target='_blank']")
            .forEach(function (a) {
                var rel = a.getAttribute("rel") || "";

                if (!rel.includes("noopener")) {
                    a.setAttribute(
                        "rel",
                        (rel + " noopener noreferrer").trim()
                    );
                }
            });
    }

    function removeLegacyYellowButtons() {
        document.querySelectorAll(
            ".btn-yellow, .yellow-button, " +
            ".warning-yellow-button, .kemet-yellow-button"
        ).forEach(function (el) {
            el.remove();
        });
    }

    ready(function () {
        setupBackToTop();
        setupForms();
        secureExternalLinks();
        removeLegacyYellowButtons();

        window.KemetV3 = {
            toast: toast
        };
    });
})();

<script>

function updateFields() {

    const action =
        document.getElementById("action_type").value;

    document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "none";

    if (action === "check_order") {
        document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "generate_ai_reply") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "create_ticket") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "send_notification") {
        document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "block";
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }
}

</script>

<script>

function updateFields() {

    const action =
        document.getElementById("action_type").value;

    document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "none";

    if (action === "check_order") {
        document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "generate_ai_reply") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "create_ticket") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "send_notification") {
        document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "block";
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }
}

</script>

<script>
function kemetUseTemplate(type) {

    const labels = {
        ai_support: "AI Customer Support",
        order_tracking: "Order Tracking",
        smart_ticket: "Smart Ticket",
        notification: "Business Notification"
    };

    const label =
        labels[type] || "Automation Template";

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
        "تثبيت قالب " +
        label +
        "؟\n\nسيتم إنشاء Workflow جاهز يمكنك تعديله."
    );

    if (!confirmed) {
        return;
    }

    window.location.href =
        "/admin/automation/template-market/" +
        encodeURIComponent(type);
}
</script>

<script>

function updateFields() {

    const action =
        document.getElementById("action_type").value;

    document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "none";

    if (action === "check_order") {
        document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "generate_ai_reply") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "create_ticket") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "send_notification") {
        document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "block";
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }
}

</script>

<script>
function kemetUseTemplate(type) {

    const labels = {
        ai_support: "AI Customer Support",
        order_tracking: "Order Tracking",
        smart_ticket: "Smart Ticket",
        notification: "Business Notification"
    };

    const label =
        labels[type] || "Automation Template";

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
        "تثبيت قالب " +
        label +
        "؟\n\nسيتم إنشاء Workflow جاهز يمكنك تعديله."
    );

    if (!confirmed) {
        return;
    }

    window.location.href =
        "/admin/automation/template-market/" +
        encodeURIComponent(type);
}
</script>

<script>

function updateFields() {

    const action =
        document.getElementById("action_type").value;

    document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "none";

    if (action === "check_order") {
        document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "generate_ai_reply") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "create_ticket") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "send_notification") {
        document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "block";
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }
}

</script>

<script>

function updateFields() {

    const action =
        document.getElementById("action_type").value;

    document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "none";

    if (action === "check_order") {
        document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "generate_ai_reply") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "create_ticket") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "send_notification") {
        document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "block";
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }
}

</script>

<script>
(function () {

    const action = document.getElementById("automationAction");
    const orderField = document.getElementById("orderField");
    const messageField = document.getElementById("messageField");
    const notificationFields = document.getElementById("notificationFields");

    function updateFields() {

        if (!action) return;

        const value = action.value;

        orderField.style.display =
            value === "check_order" ? "" : "none";

        messageField.style.display =
            value === "generate_ai_reply" ? "" : "none";

        notificationFields.style.display =
            value === "send_notification" ? "" : "none";
    }

    action.addEventListener("change", updateFields);

    updateFields();

})();
</script>

<script>

function updateFields() {

    const action =
        document.getElementById("action_type").value;

    document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "none";

    if (action === "check_order") {
        document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "generate_ai_reply") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "create_ticket") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "send_notification") {
        document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "block";
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }
}

</script>

<script>
function kemetUseTemplate(type) {

    const labels = {
        ai_support: "AI Customer Support",
        order_tracking: "Order Tracking",
        smart_ticket: "Smart Ticket",
        notification: "Business Notification"
    };

    const label =
        labels[type] || "Automation Template";

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
        "تثبيت قالب " +
        label +
        "؟\n\nسيتم إنشاء Workflow جاهز يمكنك تعديله."
    );

    if (!confirmed) {
        return;
    }

    window.location.href =
        "/admin/automation/template-market/" +
        encodeURIComponent(type);
}
</script>

<script>

function updateFields() {

    const action =
        document.getElementById("action_type").value;

    document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "none";

    if (action === "check_order") {
        document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "generate_ai_reply") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "create_ticket") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "send_notification") {
        document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "block";
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }
}

</script>

<script>

function updateFields() {

    const action =
        document.getElementById("action_type").value;

    document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "none";

    if (action === "check_order") {
        document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "generate_ai_reply") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "create_ticket") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "send_notification") {
        document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "block";
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }
}

</script>

<script>
function kemetUseTemplate(type) {
    const form = document.createElement("form");

    form.method = "POST";
    form.action = "/admin/automation/template/" + encodeURIComponent(type);
    form.style.display = "none";

    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
}
</script>

<script>

function updateFields() {

    const action =
        document.getElementById("action_type").value;

    document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "none";

    if (action === "check_order") {
        document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "generate_ai_reply") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "create_ticket") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "send_notification") {
        document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "block";
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }
}

</script>

<script>

function updateFields() {

    const action =
        document.getElementById("action_type").value;

    document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "none";

    if (action === "check_order") {
        document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "generate_ai_reply") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "create_ticket") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "send_notification") {
        document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "block";
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }
}

</script>

</body>
</html>

function updateFields() {

    const action =
        document.getElementById("action_type").value;

    document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "none";

    if (action === "check_order") {
        document.getElementById("order_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "generate_ai_reply") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "create_ticket") {
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "send_notification") {
        document.getElementById("title_field").style.display = "block";
        document.getElementById("message_field").style.display = "block";
    }
}

</script>

<script>

function updateAutomationFields() {

    const action =
        document.getElementById("action_type").value;

    const order =
        document.getElementById("order_field");

    const message =
        document.getElementById("message_field");

    const title =
        document.getElementById("title_field");

    const notification =
        document.getElementById("notification_field");

    order.style.display = "none";
    message.style.display = "none";
    title.style.display = "none";
    notification.style.display = "none";

    if (action === "check_order") {
        order.style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "generate_ai_reply") {
        message.style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "send_notification") {
        title.style.display = "block";
        notification.style.display = "block";
    }

    if (action === "create_ticket") {
        message.style.display = "block";
    }
}

</script>

{% endblock %}

<script>
(function () {
    function valueOf(name) {
        var el = document.querySelector('[name="' + name + '"]');
        return el ? el.value : "";
    }

    function updateBuilder() {
        var trigger = valueOf("trigger_type");
        var action = valueOf("action_type");
        var message = valueOf("message");
        var orderId = valueOf("order_id");
        var ticketTitle = valueOf("ticket_title");
        var notificationTitle = valueOf("notification_title");

        var triggerEl = document.getElementById("kemetTriggerPreview");
        var actionEl = document.getElementById("kemetActionPreview");
        var previewEl = document.getElementById("kemetWorkflowPreview");
        var statusEl = document.getElementById("kemetBuilderStatus");

        if (triggerEl) {
            triggerEl.textContent = trigger || "Workflow event";
        }

        if (actionEl) {
            actionEl.textContent = action || "Automation action";
        }

        var lines = [];
        lines.push("TRIGGER  : " + (trigger || "not configured"));
        lines.push("ACTION   : " + (action || "not configured"));

        if (message) {
            lines.push("MESSAGE  : " + message);
        }

        if (orderId) {
            lines.push("ORDER ID : " + orderId);
        }

        if (ticketTitle) {
            lines.push("TICKET   : " + ticketTitle);
        }

        if (notificationTitle) {
            lines.push("NOTIFY   : " + notificationTitle);
        }

        if (previewEl) {
            previewEl.textContent = lines.join("\n");
        }

        if (statusEl) {
            statusEl.textContent = trigger && action ? "READY" : "INCOMPLETE";
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener("change", function (event) {
        if (
            event.target.name === "trigger_type" ||
            event.target.name === "action_type"
        ) {
            updateBuilder();
        }
    });

    document.addEventListener("input", function (event) {
        if (
            event.target.name === "message" ||
            event.target.name === "order_id" ||
            event.target.name === "ticket_title" ||
            event.target.name === "notification_title"
        ) {
            updateBuilder();
        }
    });

    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", updateBuilder);
    } else {
        updateBuilder();
    }
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
(function () {
    function valueOf(name) {
        var el = document.querySelector('[name="' + name + '"]');
        return el ? el.value : "";
    }

    function updateBuilder() {
        var trigger = valueOf("trigger_type");
        var action = valueOf("action_type");
        var message = valueOf("message");
        var orderId = valueOf("order_id");
        var ticketTitle = valueOf("ticket_title");
        var notificationTitle = valueOf("notification_title");

        var triggerEl = document.getElementById("kemetTriggerPreview");
        var actionEl = document.getElementById("kemetActionPreview");
        var previewEl = document.getElementById("kemetWorkflowPreview");
        var statusEl = document.getElementById("kemetBuilderStatus");

        if (triggerEl) {
            triggerEl.textContent = trigger || "Workflow event";
        }

        if (actionEl) {
            actionEl.textContent = action || "Automation action";
        }

        var lines = [];
        lines.push("TRIGGER  : " + (trigger || "not configured"));
        lines.push("ACTION   : " + (action || "not configured"));

        if (message) {
            lines.push("MESSAGE  : " + message);
        }

        if (orderId) {
            lines.push("ORDER ID : " + orderId);
        }

        if (ticketTitle) {
            lines.push("TICKET   : " + ticketTitle);
        }

        if (notificationTitle) {
            lines.push("NOTIFY   : " + notificationTitle);
        }

        if (previewEl) {
            previewEl.textContent = lines.join("\n");
        }

        if (statusEl) {
            statusEl.textContent = trigger && action ? "READY" : "INCOMPLETE";
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener("change", function (event) {
        if (
            event.target.name === "trigger_type" ||
            event.target.name === "action_type"
        ) {
            updateBuilder();
        }
    });

    document.addEventListener("input", function (event) {
        if (
            event.target.name === "message" ||
            event.target.name === "order_id" ||
            event.target.name === "ticket_title" ||
            event.target.name === "notification_title"
        ) {
            updateBuilder();
        }
    });

    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", updateBuilder);
    } else {
        updateBuilder();
    }
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
async function loadBOSCommandCenter() {
    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions");

    try {
        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-loading">Analyzing business signals...</div>';

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_intelligence') }}",
            {
                method: "GET",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(
                data.message || data.error || "BOS request failed"
            );
        }

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            `${data.health_score}/100`;

        document.getElementById("bos-health-fill").style.width =
            `${data.health_score}%`;

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business intelligence is ready.";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-high").textContent =
            counts.high ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-sales").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const priorityActions =
            data.priority_actions || [];

        if (!priorityActions.length) {
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-empty">' +
                '✓ No priority actions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = priorityActions.map(item => {
            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${priority}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.title || "Business action")}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.message || "")}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(item.type || "signal")}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join("");

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value) {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent = String(value);
    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSCommandCenter
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSExecutiveCenter(){

    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions-list");

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_actions') }}",
            {
                method:"GET",
                headers:{
                    "Accept":"application/json"
                },
                credentials:"same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(!response.ok || !data.success){
            throw new Error(
                data.message || "BOS intelligence unavailable"
            );
        }

        const score = Number(data.health_score || 0);

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            Math.round(score);

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business operations are stable.";

        document.getElementById("bos-health-label").textContent =
            score >= 80 ? "Healthy" :
            score >= 60 ? "Needs attention" :
            "Critical";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-sales-count").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support-count").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation-count").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const items = Array.isArray(data.actions)
            ? data.actions
            : [];

        document.getElementById("bos-action-count").textContent =
            items.length;

        if(!items.length){
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-loading">' +
                'No priority actions detected. Operations look stable.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = items.map(function(item){

            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${escapeBOSHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.title || "Business action"
                            )}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.message || ""
                            )}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(
                            item.type || "signal"
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSExecutiveCenter
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSDecisions(){

    const container =
        document.getElementById("bos-decisions-list");

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_decisions') }}",
            {
                method:"GET",
                headers:{
                    "Accept":"application/json"
                },
                credentials:"same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(!response.ok || !data.success){
            throw new Error(
                data.message || "Decision intelligence unavailable"
            );
        }

        const decisions =
            Array.isArray(data.decisions)
                ? data.decisions
                : [];

        if(!decisions.length){

            container.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-decision-empty">' +
                'No strategic decisions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = decisions.map(function(decision){

            const priority =
                String(
                    decision.priority || "low"
                ).toLowerCase();

            return `
                <article class="bos-decision">

                    <div class="bos-decision-marker ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-decision-body">

                        <div class="bos-decision-top">
                            <strong>
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                    decision.title ||
                                    "Business decision"
                                )}
                            </strong>

                            <span class="bos-decision-priority">
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(priority)}
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="bos-decision-reason">
                            ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                decision.reason || ""
                            )}
                        </div>

                        <div class="bos-decision-action">

                            <span>
                                Recommended move
                            </span>

                            <p>
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                    decision.recommended_action ||
                                    "Review this decision."
                                )}
                            </p>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </article>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error(
            "Kemet BOS Decision Intelligence:",
            error
        );

        container.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-decision-error">' +
            'Decision intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSDecisionHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSDecisions
);
</script>

'<span class="dot"></span> All systems operational';

}

<script>
async function loadKPI(period) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials:"same-origin"}
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(data.message || data.error || "KPI request failed");
        }

        const k = data.data;
        const a = k.automation || {};
        const sp = k.support || {};
        const sa = k.sales || {};
        const r = k.revenue || {};
        const ai = k.ai || {};

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-success").textContent =
            (a.success_rate ?? 0) + "%";

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-executions").textContent =
            (a.total_executions ?? 0) + " executions";

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-total").textContent =
            sp.tickets_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-open").textContent =
            (sp.tickets_open ?? 0) + " open";

        document.getElementById("kpi-revenue").textContent =
            Number(r.paid_amount ?? 0).toFixed(2);

        document.getElementById("kpi-payments-paid").textContent =
            (r.payments_paid ?? 0) + " paid";

        document.getElementById("kpi-leads").textContent =
            sa.leads_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-converted-leads").textContent =
            ((sa.leads_by_status || {}).converted ?? 0) + " converted";

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-requests").textContent =
            ai.requests ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-tokens").textContent =
            (ai.tokens ?? 0) + " tokens";

        document.getElementById("kpi-active-workflows").textContent =
            a.active_workflows ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-total-workflows").textContent =
            (a.total_workflows ?? 0) + " total";

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("KPI dashboard error:", error);
    }
}

document.getElementById("kpi-period").addEventListener(
    "change",
    function () {
        loadKPI(this.value);
    }
);

loadKPI("30d");
</script>
<!-- dashboard-shell-end -->
</div>

<script>
(function () {
    "use strict";

    
async function transitionBOSDecision(decisionId, transition) {
    const response = await fetch(
        "/dashboard/api/bos/decision-transition",
        {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "X-CSRFToken": getCSRFToken()
            },
            credentials: "same-origin",
            body: JSON.stringify({
                decision_id: decisionId,
                transition: transition
            })
        }
    );

    const data = await response.json();

    if (!response.ok || data.ok !== true) {
        throw new Error(
            data.message || "Decision transition failed."
        );
    }

    return data;
}

function getCSRFToken() {
    const meta = document.querySelector(
        'meta[name="csrf-token"]'
    );

    return meta ? meta.getAttribute("content") : "";
}

const endpoint = "/dashboard/api/bos/control-center";

    function setText(id, value) {
        const element = document.getElementById(id);
        if (element) {
            element.textContent = value;
        }
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value ?? "")
            .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
            .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
            .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
            .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
            .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
    }

    
function renderBOSApprovalActions(decision) {
    const decisionId =
        decision.id ||
        decision.decision_id ||
        decision.decisionId;

    if (!decisionId) {
        return "";
    }

    return `
        <div class="bos-approval-actions">
            <button
                type="button"
                class="bos-approval-btn approve"
                onclick="handleBOSDecisionTransition(${decisionId}, 'approve')"
            >
                Approve
            </button>

            <button
                type="button"
                class="bos-approval-btn reject"
                onclick="handleBOSDecisionTransition(${decisionId}, 'reject')"
            >
                Reject
            </button>

            <button
                type="button"
                class="bos-approval-btn snooze"
                onclick="handleBOSDecisionTransition(${decisionId}, 'snooze')"
            >
                Snooze
            </button>
        </div>
    `;
}

async function handleBOSDecisionTransition(decisionId, transition) {
    if (!decisionId || !transition) {
        return;
    }

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
        "Apply decision transition: " + transition + "?"
    );

    if (!confirmed) {
        return;
    }

    try {
        const result = await transitionBOSDecision(
            decisionId,
            transition
        );

        window.dispatchEvent(
            new CustomEvent("bos-decision-transition", {
                detail: result
            })
        );

        await loadControlCenter();
    } catch (error) {
        console.error(
            "BOS decision transition failed:",
            error
        );

        window.alert(
            error.message ||
            "Decision transition failed."
        );
    }
}

function renderDecisions(decisions) {
        const container = document.getElementById(
            "kemet-top-decisions"
        );

        if (!container) {
            return;
        }

        if (!decisions || decisions.length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML =
                '<div style="padding:16px;color:#6b7280;">No strategic decisions currently require attention.</div>';
            return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = decisions.map(function (item) {
            const title = escapeHtml(
                item.title || item.name || "Business decision"
            );

            const priority = escapeHtml(
                item.priority || "unknown"
            );

            const priorityClass =
                priority === "high"
                    ? "color:#b91c1c;"
                    : priority === "medium"
                        ? "color:#92400e;"
                        : "color:#374151;";

            return `
                <div style="padding:16px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:10px;">
                    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;">
                        <strong>${title}</strong>
                        <span style="${priorityClass}font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;">
                            ${priority}
                        </span>
                    </div>
                    ${renderBOSApprovalActions(item)}

                </div>
            `;
        }).join("");
    }

    async function loadControlCenter() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
                method: "GET",
                credentials: "same-origin",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json"
                }
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || data.success !== true) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.message || "Executive control center unavailable"
                );
            }

            const counts = data.counts || {};
            const governance = data.governance || {};

            setText(
                "kemet-executive-focus",
                data.focus || "No executive focus available."
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-health-score",
                data.health_score ?? 0
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-total-decisions",
                counts.total ?? 0
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-high-decisions",
                counts.high ?? 0
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-medium-decisions",
                counts.medium ?? 0
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-approval-status",
                data.approval_required === true
                    ? "Approval required"
                    : "Approval not required"
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-governance-badge",
                governance.mode
                    ? String(governance.mode).toUpperCase()
                    : "ADVISORY"
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-governance-details",
                [
                    "Mode: " + (governance.mode || "advisory"),
                    "Approval required: " + (
                        governance.approval_required === true
                            ? "Yes"
                            : "No"
                    ),
                    "External execution: " + (
                        data.external_execution === true
                            ? "Enabled"
                            : "Disabled"
                    ),
                    "Database mutation: " + (
                        data.database_mutation === true
                            ? "Enabled"
                            : "Disabled"
                    )
                ].join(" | ")
            );

            renderDecisions(
                data.top_decisions || []
            );

        } catch (error) {
            const box = document.getElementById(
                "kemet-control-center-error"
            );

            if (box) {
                box.style.display = "block";
                box.textContent =
                    error.message || "Unable to load executive data.";
            }
        }
    }

    loadControlCenter();
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
    "use strict";

    const endpoint = "/dashboard/api/entitlement";

    const labels = {
        ai: "AI Assistant",
        crm: "CRM",
        support: "Customer Support",
        automation: "Automation",
        bos: "Business Intelligence",
        executive_control_center: "Executive Control Center",
        governance: "Governance",
        advanced_analytics: "Advanced Analytics",
        api_access: "API Access"
    };

    function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value ?? "")
            .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
            .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
            .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
            .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
            .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
    }

    function renderFeatures(features) {
        const container = document.getElementById(
            "kemet-entitlement-features"
        );

        if (!container) {
            return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = Object.keys(labels).map(function (key) {
            const enabled = features[key] === true;
            const label = escapeHtml(labels[key]);

            if (enabled) {
                return `
                    <div style="padding:14px;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:10px;">
                        <div style="font-weight:700;">✓ ${label}</div>
                        <div style="margin-top:5px;font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;">
                            Included in your plan
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }

            return `
                <div style="padding:14px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:10px;background:#f9fafb;">
                    <div style="font-weight:700;color:#6b7280;">
                        ${label}
                    </div>
                    <div style="margin-top:5px;font-size:12px;color:#9ca3af;">
                        Upgrade required
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join("");
    }

    async function loadEntitlement() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
                method: "GET",
                credentials: "same-origin",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json"
                }
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || data.success !== true) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.message || "Unable to load plan information."
                );
            }

            const plan = String(
                data.plan || "free"
            );

            const planElement = document.getElementById(
                "kemet-current-plan"
            );

            if (planElement) {
                planElement.textContent = plan.toUpperCase();
            }

            const subtitle = document.getElementById(
                "kemet-entitlement-subtitle"
            );

            if (subtitle) {
                subtitle.textContent =
                    "Your current subscription and available product capabilities.";
            }

            renderFeatures(
                data.features || {}
            );

        } catch (error) {
            const box = document.getElementById(
                "kemet-entitlement-error"
            );

            if (box) {
                box.style.display = "block";
                box.textContent =
                    error.message || "Unable to load subscription information.";
            }
        }
    }

    loadEntitlement();
})();
</script>


<script>
/* KEMET_BOS_COMMAND_CENTER_V1 */
(async function () {
    const endpoint = "/dashboard/api/bos/control-center";

    const errorBox = document.getElementById(
        "kemet-control-center-error"
    );

    const decisionsBox = document.getElementById(
        "kemet-bos-decisions"
    );

    function setText(id, value) {
        const node = document.getElementById(id);
        if (node) node.textContent = value;
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value ?? "")
            .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
            .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
            .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
            .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
            .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");
    }

    function renderDecision(item) {
        const priority = String(
            item.priority || "low"
        ).toLowerCase();

        const score = Number(item.decision_score || 0);
        const impact = item.impact ?? 0;
        const urgency = item.urgency ?? 0;
        const confidence = Number(
            item.confidence ?? 0
        );

        return `
            <article class="kemet-bos-decision">
                <div class="kemet-bos-decision-top">
                    <div>
                        <h4>${escapeHtml(
                            item.title || "Business Decision"
                        )}</h4>
                        <div class="kemet-bos-meta">
                            <span class="kemet-bos-badge ${priority === "high"
                                ? "kemet-bos-high"
                                : priority === "medium"
                                    ? "kemet-bos-medium"
                                    : ""
                            }">
                                ${escapeHtml(priority.toUpperCase())}
                            </span>

                            <span class="kemet-bos-badge">
                                Score ${score.toFixed(2)}
                            </span>

                            <span class="kemet-bos-badge">
                                Impact ${escapeHtml(impact)}
                            </span>

                            <span class="kemet-bos-badge">
                                Urgency ${escapeHtml(urgency)}
                            </span>

                            <span class="kemet-bos-badge">
                                Confidence ${(confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                            </span>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <span class="kemet-bos-badge">
                        ${escapeHtml(item.status || "recommended")}
                    </span>
                </div>

                <div class="kemet-bos-decision-reason">
                    ${escapeHtml(item.reason || "")}
                </div>

                ${item.why_now ? `
                    <div class="kemet-bos-decision-reason">
                        <strong>Why now:</strong>
                        ${escapeHtml(item.why_now)}
                    </div>
                ` : ""}

                <div class="kemet-bos-action">
                    <strong>Recommended Action</strong>
                    ${escapeHtml(
                        item.recommended_action ||
                        "Review this business decision."
                    )}
                </div>

                ${item.expected_outcome ? `
                    <div class="kemet-bos-decision-reason">
                        <strong>Expected Outcome:</strong>
                        ${escapeHtml(item.expected_outcome)}
                    </div>
                ` : ""}
            </article>
        `;
    }

    try {
        const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
            method: "GET",
            headers: {
                "Accept": "application/json"
            },
            credentials: "same-origin"
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                "BOS endpoint returned HTTP " +
                response.status
            );
        }

        const data = await response.json();

        setText(
            "kemet-bos-health-score",
            Number(data.health_score || 0).toFixed(1)
        );

        setText(
            "kemet-bos-summary",
            data.summary || "Business intelligence available."
        );

        setText(
            "kemet-bos-focus",
            data.focus || "Operations monitored."
        );

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        setText(
            "kemet-bos-total",
            counts.total ?? 0
        );

        setText(
            "kemet-bos-high",
            counts.high ?? 0
        );

        setText(
            "kemet-bos-medium",
            counts.medium ?? 0
        );

        setText(
            "kemet-bos-signals",
            data.signal_count ??
            data.signals ??
            counts.total ??
            0
        );

        const decisions = data.decisions || [];

        if (!decisions.length) {
            decisionsBox.innerHTML =
                '<div class="kemet-bos-loading">' +
                'No strategic decisions currently require attention.' +
                '</div>';
        } else {
            decisionsBox.innerHTML =
                decisions.map(renderDecision).join("");
        }

        setText(
            "kemet-bos-decision-status",
            decisions.length
                ? "Live"
                : "Stable"
        );

    } catch (error) {
        console.error(
            "KEMET BOS Command Center:",
            error
        );

        if (errorBox) {
            errorBox.hidden = false;
            errorBox.textContent =
                "Unable to load BOS intelligence. " +
                "Please refresh the dashboard.";
        }

        if (decisionsBox) {
            decisionsBox.innerHTML =
                '<div class="kemet-bos-error">' +
                'BOS intelligence temporarily unavailable.' +
                '</div>';
        }
    }
})();
</script>

async function checkHealth(){
try{
const r=await fetch("/api/health",{credentials:"same-origin"});
if(!r.ok)throw new Error();

document.querySelector(".status").innerHTML=
'<span class="dot"></span> All systems operational';
}catch(e){
document.querySelector(".status").innerHTML=
'<span class="dot" style="background:#ff5d73"></span> System check failed';
}
}

checkHealth();
</script>


<script>
async function loadKPI(period) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials:"same-origin"}
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(data.message || data.error || "KPI request failed");
        }

        const k = data.data;
        const a = k.automation || {};
        const sp = k.support || {};
        const sa = k.sales || {};
        const r = k.revenue || {};
        const ai = k.ai || {};

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-success").textContent =
            (a.success_rate ?? 0) + "%";

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-executions").textContent =
            (a.total_executions ?? 0) + " executions";

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-total").textContent =
            sp.tickets_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-open").textContent =
            (sp.tickets_open ?? 0) + " open";

        document.getElementById("kpi-revenue").textContent =
            Number(r.paid_amount ?? 0).toFixed(2);

        document.getElementById("kpi-payments-paid").textContent =
            (r.payments_paid ?? 0) + " paid";

        document.getElementById("kpi-leads").textContent =
            sa.leads_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-converted-leads").textContent =
            ((sa.leads_by_status || {}).converted ?? 0) + " converted";

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-requests").textContent =
            ai.requests ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-tokens").textContent =
            (ai.tokens ?? 0) + " tokens";

        document.getElementById("kpi-active-workflows").textContent =
            a.active_workflows ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-total-workflows").textContent =
            (a.total_workflows ?? 0) + " total";

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("KPI dashboard error:", error);
    }
}

document.getElementById("kpi-period").addEventListener(
    "change",
    function () {
        loadKPI(this.value);
    }
);

loadKPI("30d");
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSCommandCenter() {
    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions");

    try {
        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-loading">Analyzing business signals...</div>';

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_intelligence') }}",
            {
                method: "GET",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(
                data.message || data.error || "BOS request failed"
            );
        }

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            `${data.health_score}/100`;

        document.getElementById("bos-health-fill").style.width =
            `${data.health_score}%`;

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business intelligence is ready.";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-high").textContent =
            counts.high ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-sales").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const priorityActions =
            data.priority_actions || [];

        if (!priorityActions.length) {
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-empty">' +
                '✓ No priority actions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = priorityActions.map(item => {
            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${priority}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.title || "Business action")}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.message || "")}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(item.type || "signal")}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join("");

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value) {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent = String(value);
    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSCommandCenter
);
</script>

async function loadBOSExecutiveCenter(){

                },

        const score = Number(data.health_score || 0);

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            Math.round(score);

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business operations are stable.";

        document.getElementById("bos-health-label").textContent =
            score >= 80 ? "Healthy" :
            score >= 60 ? "Needs attention" :
            "Critical";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-sales-count").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support-count").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation-count").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const items = Array.isArray(data.actions)
            ? data.actions
            : [];

        document.getElementById("bos-action-count").textContent =
            items.length;

        if(!items.length){
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-loading">' +
                'No priority actions detected. Operations look stable.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = items.map(function(item){

            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${escapeBOSHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.title || "Business action"
                            )}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.message || ""
                            )}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(
                            item.type || "signal"
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSExecutiveCenter
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadKPI(period) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials:"same-origin"}
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(data.message || data.error || "KPI request failed");
        }

        const k = data.data;
        const a = k.automation || {};
        const sp = k.support || {};
        const sa = k.sales || {};
        const r = k.revenue || {};
        const ai = k.ai || {};

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-success").textContent =
            (a.success_rate ?? 0) + "%";

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-executions").textContent =
            (a.total_executions ?? 0) + " executions";

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-total").textContent =
            sp.tickets_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-open").textContent =
            (sp.tickets_open ?? 0) + " open";

        document.getElementById("kpi-revenue").textContent =
            Number(r.paid_amount ?? 0).toFixed(2);

        document.getElementById("kpi-payments-paid").textContent =
            (r.payments_paid ?? 0) + " paid";

        document.getElementById("kpi-leads").textContent =
            sa.leads_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-converted-leads").textContent =
            ((sa.leads_by_status || {}).converted ?? 0) + " converted";

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-requests").textContent =
            ai.requests ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-tokens").textContent =
            (ai.tokens ?? 0) + " tokens";

        document.getElementById("kpi-active-workflows").textContent =
            a.active_workflows ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-total-workflows").textContent =
            (a.total_workflows ?? 0) + " total";

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("KPI dashboard error:", error);
    }
}

document.getElementById("kpi-period").addEventListener(
    "change",
    function () {
        loadKPI(this.value);
    }
);

loadKPI("30d");
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSCommandCenter() {
    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions");

    try {
        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-loading">Analyzing business signals...</div>';

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_intelligence') }}",
            {
                method: "GET",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(
                data.message || data.error || "BOS request failed"
            );
        }

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            `${data.health_score}/100`;

        document.getElementById("bos-health-fill").style.width =
            `${data.health_score}%`;

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business intelligence is ready.";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-high").textContent =
            counts.high ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-sales").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const priorityActions =
            data.priority_actions || [];

        if (!priorityActions.length) {
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-empty">' +
                '✓ No priority actions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = priorityActions.map(item => {
            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${priority}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.title || "Business action")}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.message || "")}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(item.type || "signal")}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join("");

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value) {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent = String(value);
    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSCommandCenter
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadKPI(period) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials:"same-origin"}
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(data.message || data.error || "KPI request failed");
        }

        const k = data.data;
        const a = k.automation || {};
        const sp = k.support || {};
        const sa = k.sales || {};
        const r = k.revenue || {};
        const ai = k.ai || {};

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-success").textContent =
            (a.success_rate ?? 0) + "%";

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-executions").textContent =
            (a.total_executions ?? 0) + " executions";

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-total").textContent =
            sp.tickets_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-open").textContent =
            (sp.tickets_open ?? 0) + " open";

        document.getElementById("kpi-revenue").textContent =
            Number(r.paid_amount ?? 0).toFixed(2);

        document.getElementById("kpi-payments-paid").textContent =
            (r.payments_paid ?? 0) + " paid";

        document.getElementById("kpi-leads").textContent =
            sa.leads_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-converted-leads").textContent =
            ((sa.leads_by_status || {}).converted ?? 0) + " converted";

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-requests").textContent =
            ai.requests ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-tokens").textContent =
            (ai.tokens ?? 0) + " tokens";

        document.getElementById("kpi-active-workflows").textContent =
            a.active_workflows ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-total-workflows").textContent =
            (a.total_workflows ?? 0) + " total";

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("KPI dashboard error:", error);
    }
}

document.getElementById("kpi-period").addEventListener(
    "change",
    function () {
        loadKPI(this.value);
    }
);

loadKPI("30d");
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSCommandCenter() {
    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions");

    try {
        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-loading">Analyzing business signals...</div>';

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_intelligence') }}",
            {
                method: "GET",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(
                data.message || data.error || "BOS request failed"
            );
        }

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            `${data.health_score}/100`;

        document.getElementById("bos-health-fill").style.width =
            `${data.health_score}%`;

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business intelligence is ready.";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-high").textContent =
            counts.high ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-sales").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const priorityActions =
            data.priority_actions || [];

        if (!priorityActions.length) {
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-empty">' +
                '✓ No priority actions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = priorityActions.map(item => {
            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${priority}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.title || "Business action")}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.message || "")}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(item.type || "signal")}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join("");

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value) {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent = String(value);
    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSCommandCenter
);
</script>

'<span class="dot"></span> All systems operational';

<script>
async function loadKPI(period) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials:"same-origin"}
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(data.message || data.error || "KPI request failed");
        }

        const k = data.data;
        const a = k.automation || {};
        const sp = k.support || {};
        const sa = k.sales || {};
        const r = k.revenue || {};
        const ai = k.ai || {};

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-success").textContent =
            (a.success_rate ?? 0) + "%";

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-executions").textContent =
            (a.total_executions ?? 0) + " executions";

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-total").textContent =
            sp.tickets_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-open").textContent =
            (sp.tickets_open ?? 0) + " open";

        document.getElementById("kpi-revenue").textContent =
            Number(r.paid_amount ?? 0).toFixed(2);

        document.getElementById("kpi-payments-paid").textContent =
            (r.payments_paid ?? 0) + " paid";

        document.getElementById("kpi-leads").textContent =
            sa.leads_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-converted-leads").textContent =
            ((sa.leads_by_status || {}).converted ?? 0) + " converted";

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-requests").textContent =
            ai.requests ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-tokens").textContent =
            (ai.tokens ?? 0) + " tokens";

        document.getElementById("kpi-active-workflows").textContent =
            a.active_workflows ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-total-workflows").textContent =
            (a.total_workflows ?? 0) + " total";

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("KPI dashboard error:", error);
    }
}

document.getElementById("kpi-period").addEventListener(
    "change",
    function () {
        loadKPI(this.value);
    }
);

loadKPI("30d");
