<script>
async function loadKPI(period) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials:"same-origin"}
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(data.message || data.error || "KPI request failed");
        }

        const k = data.data;
        const a = k.automation || {};
        const sp = k.support || {};
        const sa = k.sales || {};
        const r = k.revenue || {};
        const ai = k.ai || {};

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-success").textContent =
            (a.success_rate ?? 0) + "%";

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-executions").textContent =
            (a.total_executions ?? 0) + " executions";

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-total").textContent =
            sp.tickets_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-open").textContent =
            (sp.tickets_open ?? 0) + " open";

        document.getElementById("kpi-revenue").textContent =
            Number(r.paid_amount ?? 0).toFixed(2);

        document.getElementById("kpi-payments-paid").textContent =
            (r.payments_paid ?? 0) + " paid";

        document.getElementById("kpi-leads").textContent =
            sa.leads_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-converted-leads").textContent =
            ((sa.leads_by_status || {}).converted ?? 0) + " converted";

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-requests").textContent =
            ai.requests ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-tokens").textContent =
            (ai.tokens ?? 0) + " tokens";

        document.getElementById("kpi-active-workflows").textContent =
            a.active_workflows ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-total-workflows").textContent =
            (a.total_workflows ?? 0) + " total";

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("KPI dashboard error:", error);
    }
}

document.getElementById("kpi-period").addEventListener(
    "change",
    function () {
        loadKPI(this.value);
    }
);

loadKPI("30d");
</script>

<script>
(function () {
    "use strict";

    const endpoint = "/dashboard/api/bos/control-center";

    function setText(id, value) {
        const element = document.getElementById(id);
        if (element) {
            element.textContent = value;
        }
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value ?? "")
            .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
            .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
            .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
            .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
            .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
    }

    function renderDecisions(decisions) {
        const container = document.getElementById(
            "kemet-top-decisions"
        );

        if (!container) {
            return;
        }

        if (!decisions || decisions.length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML =
                '<div style="padding:16px;color:#6b7280;">No strategic decisions currently require attention.</div>';
            return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = decisions.map(function (item) {
            const title = escapeHtml(
                item.title || item.name || "Business decision"
            );

            const priority = escapeHtml(
                item.priority || "unknown"
            );

            const priorityClass =
                priority === "high"
                    ? "color:#b91c1c;"
                    : priority === "medium"
                        ? "color:#92400e;"
                        : "color:#374151;";

            return `
                <div style="padding:16px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:10px;">
                    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;">
                        <strong>${title}</strong>
                        <span style="${priorityClass}font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;">
                            ${priority}
                        </span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join("");
    }

    async function loadControlCenter() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
                method: "GET",
                credentials: "same-origin",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json"
                }
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || data.success !== true) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.message || "Executive control center unavailable"
                );
            }

            const counts = data.counts || {};
            const governance = data.governance || {};

            setText(
                "kemet-executive-focus",
                data.focus || "No executive focus available."
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-health-score",
                data.health_score ?? 0
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-total-decisions",
                counts.total ?? 0
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-high-decisions",
                counts.high ?? 0
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-medium-decisions",
                counts.medium ?? 0
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-approval-status",
                data.approval_required === true
                    ? "Approval required"
                    : "Approval not required"
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-governance-badge",
                governance.mode
                    ? String(governance.mode).toUpperCase()
                    : "ADVISORY"
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-governance-details",
                [
                    "Mode: " + (governance.mode || "advisory"),
                    "Approval required: " + (
                        governance.approval_required === true
                            ? "Yes"
                            : "No"
                    ),
                    "External execution: " + (
                        data.external_execution === true
                            ? "Enabled"
                            : "Disabled"
                    ),
                    "Database mutation: " + (
                        data.database_mutation === true
                            ? "Enabled"
                            : "Disabled"
                    )
                ].join(" | ")
            );

            renderDecisions(
                data.top_decisions || []
            );

        } catch (error) {
            const box = document.getElementById(
                "kemet-control-center-error"
            );

            if (box) {
                box.style.display = "block";
                box.textContent =
                    error.message || "Unable to load executive data.";
            }
        }
    }

    loadControlCenter();
})();
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSCommandCenter() {
    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions");

    try {
        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-loading">Analyzing business signals...</div>';

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_intelligence') }}",
            {
                method: "GET",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(
                data.message || data.error || "BOS request failed"
            );
        }

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            `${data.health_score}/100`;

        document.getElementById("bos-health-fill").style.width =
            `${data.health_score}%`;

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business intelligence is ready.";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-high").textContent =
            counts.high ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-sales").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const priorityActions =
            data.priority_actions || [];

        if (!priorityActions.length) {
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-empty">' +
                '✓ No priority actions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = priorityActions.map(item => {
            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${priority}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.title || "Business action")}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.message || "")}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(item.type || "signal")}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join("");

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value) {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent = String(value);
    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSCommandCenter
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSExecutiveCenter(){

    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions-list");

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_actions') }}",
            {
                method:"GET",
                headers:{
                    "Accept":"application/json"
                },
                credentials:"same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(!response.ok || !data.success){
            throw new Error(
                data.message || "BOS intelligence unavailable"
            );
        }

        const score = Number(data.health_score || 0);

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            Math.round(score);

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business operations are stable.";

        document.getElementById("bos-health-label").textContent =
            score >= 80 ? "Healthy" :
            score >= 60 ? "Needs attention" :
            "Critical";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-sales-count").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support-count").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation-count").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const items = Array.isArray(data.actions)
            ? data.actions
            : [];

        document.getElementById("bos-action-count").textContent =
            items.length;

        if(!items.length){
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-loading">' +
                'No priority actions detected. Operations look stable.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = items.map(function(item){

            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${escapeBOSHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.title || "Business action"
                            )}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.message || ""
                            )}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(
                            item.type || "signal"
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSExecutiveCenter
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSDecisions(){

    const container =
        document.getElementById("bos-decisions-list");

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_decisions') }}",
            {
                method:"GET",
                headers:{
                    "Accept":"application/json"
                },
                credentials:"same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(!response.ok || !data.success){
            throw new Error(
                data.message || "Decision intelligence unavailable"
            );
        }

        const decisions =
            Array.isArray(data.decisions)
                ? data.decisions
                : [];

        if(!decisions.length){

            container.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-decision-empty">' +
                'No strategic decisions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = decisions.map(function(decision){

            const priority =
                String(
                    decision.priority || "low"
                ).toLowerCase();

            return `
                <article class="bos-decision">

                    <div class="bos-decision-marker ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-decision-body">

                        <div class="bos-decision-top">
                            <strong>
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                    decision.title ||
                                    "Business decision"
                                )}
                            </strong>

                            <span class="bos-decision-priority">
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(priority)}
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="bos-decision-reason">
                            ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                decision.reason || ""
                            )}
                        </div>

                        <div class="bos-decision-action">

                            <span>
                                Recommended move
                            </span>

                            <p>
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                    decision.recommended_action ||
                                    "Review this decision."
                                )}
                            </p>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </article>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error(
            "Kemet BOS Decision Intelligence:",
            error
        );

        container.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-decision-error">' +
            'Decision intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSDecisionHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSDecisions
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadKPI(period) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials:"same-origin"}
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(data.message || data.error || "KPI request failed");
        }

        const k = data.data;
        const a = k.automation || {};
        const sp = k.support || {};
        const sa = k.sales || {};
        const r = k.revenue || {};
        const ai = k.ai || {};

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-success").textContent =
            (a.success_rate ?? 0) + "%";

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-executions").textContent =
            (a.total_executions ?? 0) + " executions";

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-total").textContent =
            sp.tickets_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-open").textContent =
            (sp.tickets_open ?? 0) + " open";

        document.getElementById("kpi-revenue").textContent =
            Number(r.paid_amount ?? 0).toFixed(2);

        document.getElementById("kpi-payments-paid").textContent =
            (r.payments_paid ?? 0) + " paid";

        document.getElementById("kpi-leads").textContent =
            sa.leads_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-converted-leads").textContent =
            ((sa.leads_by_status || {}).converted ?? 0) + " converted";

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-requests").textContent =
            ai.requests ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-tokens").textContent =
            (ai.tokens ?? 0) + " tokens";

        document.getElementById("kpi-active-workflows").textContent =
            a.active_workflows ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-total-workflows").textContent =
            (a.total_workflows ?? 0) + " total";

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("KPI dashboard error:", error);
    }
}

document.getElementById("kpi-period").addEventListener(
    "change",
    function () {
        loadKPI(this.value);
    }
);

loadKPI("30d");

<script>
(function () {
    "use strict";

    const endpoint = "/dashboard/api/bos/control-center";

    function setText(id, value) {
        const element = document.getElementById(id);
        if (element) {
            element.textContent = value;
        }
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value ?? "")
            .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
            .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
            .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
            .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
            .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
    }

    function renderDecisions(decisions) {
        const container = document.getElementById(
            "kemet-top-decisions"
        );

        if (!container) {
            return;
        }

        if (!decisions || decisions.length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML =
                '<div style="padding:16px;color:#6b7280;">No strategic decisions currently require attention.</div>';
            return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = decisions.map(function (item) {
            const title = escapeHtml(
                item.title || item.name || "Business decision"
            );

            const priority = escapeHtml(
                item.priority || "unknown"
            );

            const priorityClass =
                priority === "high"
                    ? "color:#b91c1c;"
                    : priority === "medium"
                        ? "color:#92400e;"
                        : "color:#374151;";

            return `
                <div style="padding:16px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:10px;">
                    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;">
                        <strong>${title}</strong>
                        <span style="${priorityClass}font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;">
                            ${priority}
                        </span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join("");
    }

    async function loadControlCenter() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
                method: "GET",
                credentials: "same-origin",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json"
                }
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || data.success !== true) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.message || "Executive control center unavailable"
                );
            }

            const counts = data.counts || {};
            const governance = data.governance || {};

            setText(
                "kemet-executive-focus",
                data.focus || "No executive focus available."
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-health-score",
                data.health_score ?? 0
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-total-decisions",
                counts.total ?? 0
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-high-decisions",
                counts.high ?? 0
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-medium-decisions",
                counts.medium ?? 0
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-approval-status",
                data.approval_required === true
                    ? "Approval required"
                    : "Approval not required"
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-governance-badge",
                governance.mode
                    ? String(governance.mode).toUpperCase()
                    : "ADVISORY"
            );

            setText(
                "kemet-governance-details",
                [
                    "Mode: " + (governance.mode || "advisory"),
                    "Approval required: " + (
                        governance.approval_required === true
                            ? "Yes"
                            : "No"
                    ),
                    "External execution: " + (
                        data.external_execution === true
                            ? "Enabled"
                            : "Disabled"
                    ),
                    "Database mutation: " + (
                        data.database_mutation === true
                            ? "Enabled"
                            : "Disabled"
                    )
                ].join(" | ")
            );

            renderDecisions(
                data.top_decisions || []
            );

        } catch (error) {
            const box = document.getElementById(
                "kemet-control-center-error"
            );

            if (box) {
                box.style.display = "block";
                box.textContent =
                    error.message || "Unable to load executive data.";
            }
        }
    }

    loadControlCenter();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
async function loadBOSCommandCenter() {
    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions");

    try {
        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-loading">Analyzing business signals...</div>';

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_intelligence') }}",
            {
                method: "GET",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(
                data.message || data.error || "BOS request failed"
            );
        }

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            `${data.health_score}/100`;

        document.getElementById("bos-health-fill").style.width =
            `${data.health_score}%`;

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business intelligence is ready.";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-high").textContent =
            counts.high ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-sales").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const priorityActions =
            data.priority_actions || [];

        if (!priorityActions.length) {
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-empty">' +
                '✓ No priority actions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = priorityActions.map(item => {
            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${priority}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.title || "Business action")}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.message || "")}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(item.type || "signal")}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join("");

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value) {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent = String(value);
    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSCommandCenter
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSExecutiveCenter(){

    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions-list");

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_actions') }}",
            {
                method:"GET",
                headers:{
                    "Accept":"application/json"
                },
                credentials:"same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(!response.ok || !data.success){
            throw new Error(
                data.message || "BOS intelligence unavailable"
            );
        }

        const score = Number(data.health_score || 0);

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            Math.round(score);

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business operations are stable.";

        document.getElementById("bos-health-label").textContent =
            score >= 80 ? "Healthy" :
            score >= 60 ? "Needs attention" :
            "Critical";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-sales-count").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support-count").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation-count").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const items = Array.isArray(data.actions)
            ? data.actions
            : [];

        document.getElementById("bos-action-count").textContent =
            items.length;

        if(!items.length){
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-loading">' +
                'No priority actions detected. Operations look stable.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = items.map(function(item){

            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${escapeBOSHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.title || "Business action"
                            )}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.message || ""
                            )}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(
                            item.type || "signal"
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSExecutiveCenter
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSDecisions(){

    const container =
        document.getElementById("bos-decisions-list");

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_decisions') }}",
            {
                method:"GET",
                headers:{
                    "Accept":"application/json"
                },
                credentials:"same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(!response.ok || !data.success){
            throw new Error(
                data.message || "Decision intelligence unavailable"
            );
        }

        const decisions =
            Array.isArray(data.decisions)
                ? data.decisions
                : [];

        if(!decisions.length){

            container.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-decision-empty">' +
                'No strategic decisions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = decisions.map(function(decision){

            const priority =
                String(
                    decision.priority || "low"
                ).toLowerCase();

            return `
                <article class="bos-decision">

                    <div class="bos-decision-marker ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-decision-body">

                        <div class="bos-decision-top">
                            <strong>
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                    decision.title ||
                                    "Business decision"
                                )}
                            </strong>

                            <span class="bos-decision-priority">
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(priority)}
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="bos-decision-reason">
                            ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                decision.reason || ""
                            )}
                        </div>

                        <div class="bos-decision-action">

                            <span>
                                Recommended move
                            </span>

                            <p>
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                    decision.recommended_action ||
                                    "Review this decision."
                                )}
                            </p>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </article>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error(
            "Kemet BOS Decision Intelligence:",
            error
        );

        container.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-decision-error">' +
            'Decision intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSDecisionHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSDecisions
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadKPI(period) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials:"same-origin"}
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(data.message || data.error || "KPI request failed");
        }

        const k = data.data;
        const a = k.automation || {};
        const sp = k.support || {};
        const sa = k.sales || {};
        const r = k.revenue || {};
        const ai = k.ai || {};

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-success").textContent =
            (a.success_rate ?? 0) + "%";

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-executions").textContent =
            (a.total_executions ?? 0) + " executions";

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-total").textContent =
            sp.tickets_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-open").textContent =
            (sp.tickets_open ?? 0) + " open";

        document.getElementById("kpi-revenue").textContent =
            Number(r.paid_amount ?? 0).toFixed(2);

        document.getElementById("kpi-payments-paid").textContent =
            (r.payments_paid ?? 0) + " paid";

        document.getElementById("kpi-leads").textContent =
            sa.leads_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-converted-leads").textContent =
            ((sa.leads_by_status || {}).converted ?? 0) + " converted";

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-requests").textContent =
            ai.requests ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-tokens").textContent =
            (ai.tokens ?? 0) + " tokens";

        document.getElementById("kpi-active-workflows").textContent =
            a.active_workflows ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-total-workflows").textContent =
            (a.total_workflows ?? 0) + " total";

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("KPI dashboard error:", error);
    }
}

document.getElementById("kpi-period").addEventListener(
    "change",
    function () {
        loadKPI(this.value);
    }
);

loadKPI("30d");
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSCommandCenter() {
    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions");

    try {
        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-loading">Analyzing business signals...</div>';

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_intelligence') }}",
            {
                method: "GET",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(
                data.message || data.error || "BOS request failed"
            );
        }

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            `${data.health_score}/100`;

        document.getElementById("bos-health-fill").style.width =
            `${data.health_score}%`;

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business intelligence is ready.";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-high").textContent =
            counts.high ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-sales").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const priorityActions =
            data.priority_actions || [];

        if (!priorityActions.length) {
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-empty">' +
                '✓ No priority actions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = priorityActions.map(item => {
            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${priority}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.title || "Business action")}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.message || "")}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(item.type || "signal")}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join("");

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value) {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent = String(value);
    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSCommandCenter
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSExecutiveCenter(){

    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions-list");

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_actions') }}",
            {
                method:"GET",
                headers:{
                    "Accept":"application/json"
                },
                credentials:"same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(!response.ok || !data.success){
            throw new Error(
                data.message || "BOS intelligence unavailable"
            );
        }

        const score = Number(data.health_score || 0);

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            Math.round(score);

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business operations are stable.";

        document.getElementById("bos-health-label").textContent =
            score >= 80 ? "Healthy" :
            score >= 60 ? "Needs attention" :
            "Critical";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-sales-count").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support-count").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation-count").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const items = Array.isArray(data.actions)
            ? data.actions
            : [];

        document.getElementById("bos-action-count").textContent =
            items.length;

        if(!items.length){
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-loading">' +
                'No priority actions detected. Operations look stable.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = items.map(function(item){

            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${escapeBOSHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.title || "Business action"
                            )}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.message || ""
                            )}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(
                            item.type || "signal"
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSExecutiveCenter
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSDecisions(){

    const container =
        document.getElementById("bos-decisions-list");

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_decisions') }}",
            {
                method:"GET",
                headers:{
                    "Accept":"application/json"
                },
                credentials:"same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(!response.ok || !data.success){
            throw new Error(
                data.message || "Decision intelligence unavailable"
            );
        }

        const decisions =
            Array.isArray(data.decisions)
                ? data.decisions
                : [];

        if(!decisions.length){

            container.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-decision-empty">' +
                'No strategic decisions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = decisions.map(function(decision){

            const priority =
                String(
                    decision.priority || "low"
                ).toLowerCase();

            return `
                <article class="bos-decision">

                    <div class="bos-decision-marker ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-decision-body">

                        <div class="bos-decision-top">
                            <strong>
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                    decision.title ||
                                    "Business decision"
                                )}
                            </strong>

                            <span class="bos-decision-priority">
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(priority)}
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="bos-decision-reason">
                            ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                decision.reason || ""
                            )}
                        </div>

                        <div class="bos-decision-action">

                            <span>
                                Recommended move
                            </span>

                            <p>
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                    decision.recommended_action ||
                                    "Review this decision."
                                )}
                            </p>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </article>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error(
            "Kemet BOS Decision Intelligence:",
            error
        );

        container.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-decision-error">' +
            'Decision intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSDecisionHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSDecisions
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadKPI(period) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials:"same-origin"}
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(data.message || data.error || "KPI request failed");
        }

        const k = data.data;
        const a = k.automation || {};
        const sp = k.support || {};
        const sa = k.sales || {};
        const r = k.revenue || {};
        const ai = k.ai || {};

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-success").textContent =
            (a.success_rate ?? 0) + "%";

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-executions").textContent =
            (a.total_executions ?? 0) + " executions";

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-total").textContent =
            sp.tickets_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-open").textContent =
            (sp.tickets_open ?? 0) + " open";

        document.getElementById("kpi-revenue").textContent =
            Number(r.paid_amount ?? 0).toFixed(2);

        document.getElementById("kpi-payments-paid").textContent =
            (r.payments_paid ?? 0) + " paid";

        document.getElementById("kpi-leads").textContent =
            sa.leads_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-converted-leads").textContent =
            ((sa.leads_by_status || {}).converted ?? 0) + " converted";

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-requests").textContent =
            ai.requests ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-tokens").textContent =
            (ai.tokens ?? 0) + " tokens";

        document.getElementById("kpi-active-workflows").textContent =
            a.active_workflows ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-total-workflows").textContent =
            (a.total_workflows ?? 0) + " total";

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("KPI dashboard error:", error);
    }
}

document.getElementById("kpi-period").addEventListener(
    "change",
    function () {
        loadKPI(this.value);
    }
);

loadKPI("30d");
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSCommandCenter() {
    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions");

    try {
        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-loading">Analyzing business signals...</div>';

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_intelligence') }}",
            {
                method: "GET",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(
                data.message || data.error || "BOS request failed"
            );
        }

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            `${data.health_score}/100`;

        document.getElementById("bos-health-fill").style.width =
            `${data.health_score}%`;

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business intelligence is ready.";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-high").textContent =
            counts.high ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-sales").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const priorityActions =
            data.priority_actions || [];

        if (!priorityActions.length) {
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-empty">' +
                '✓ No priority actions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = priorityActions.map(item => {
            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${priority}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.title || "Business action")}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.message || "")}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(item.type || "signal")}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join("");

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value) {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent = String(value);
    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSCommandCenter
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSExecutiveCenter(){

    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions-list");

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_actions') }}",
            {
                method:"GET",
                headers:{
                    "Accept":"application/json"
                },
                credentials:"same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(!response.ok || !data.success){
            throw new Error(
                data.message || "BOS intelligence unavailable"
            );
        }

        const score = Number(data.health_score || 0);

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            Math.round(score);

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business operations are stable.";

        document.getElementById("bos-health-label").textContent =
            score >= 80 ? "Healthy" :
            score >= 60 ? "Needs attention" :
            "Critical";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-sales-count").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support-count").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation-count").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const items = Array.isArray(data.actions)
            ? data.actions
            : [];

        document.getElementById("bos-action-count").textContent =
            items.length;

        if(!items.length){
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-loading">' +
                'No priority actions detected. Operations look stable.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = items.map(function(item){

            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${escapeBOSHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.title || "Business action"
                            )}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.message || ""
                            )}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(
                            item.type || "signal"
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSExecutiveCenter

<script>
async function loadBOSDecisions(){

    const container =
        document.getElementById("bos-decisions-list");

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_decisions') }}",
            {
                method:"GET",
                headers:{
                    "Accept":"application/json"
                },
                credentials:"same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(!response.ok || !data.success){
            throw new Error(
                data.message || "Decision intelligence unavailable"
            );
        }

        const decisions =
            Array.isArray(data.decisions)
                ? data.decisions
                : [];

        if(!decisions.length){

            container.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-decision-empty">' +
                'No strategic decisions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = decisions.map(function(decision){

            const priority =
                String(
                    decision.priority || "low"
                ).toLowerCase();

            return `
                <article class="bos-decision">

                    <div class="bos-decision-marker ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-decision-body">

                        <div class="bos-decision-top">
                            <strong>
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                    decision.title ||
                                    "Business decision"
                                )}
                            </strong>

                            <span class="bos-decision-priority">
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(priority)}
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="bos-decision-reason">
                            ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                decision.reason || ""
                            )}
                        </div>

                        <div class="bos-decision-action">

                            <span>
                                Recommended move
                            </span>

                            <p>
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                    decision.recommended_action ||
                                    "Review this decision."
                                )}
                            </p>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </article>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error(
            "Kemet BOS Decision Intelligence:",
            error
        );

        container.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-decision-error">' +
            'Decision intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSDecisionHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSDecisions
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadKPI(period) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials:"same-origin"}
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(data.message || data.error || "KPI request failed");
        }

        const k = data.data;
        const a = k.automation || {};
        const sp = k.support || {};
        const sa = k.sales || {};
        const r = k.revenue || {};
        const ai = k.ai || {};

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-success").textContent =
            (a.success_rate ?? 0) + "%";

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-executions").textContent =
            (a.total_executions ?? 0) + " executions";

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-total").textContent =
            sp.tickets_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-open").textContent =
            (sp.tickets_open ?? 0) + " open";

        document.getElementById("kpi-revenue").textContent =
            Number(r.paid_amount ?? 0).toFixed(2);

        document.getElementById("kpi-payments-paid").textContent =
            (r.payments_paid ?? 0) + " paid";

        document.getElementById("kpi-leads").textContent =
            sa.leads_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-converted-leads").textContent =
            ((sa.leads_by_status || {}).converted ?? 0) + " converted";

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-requests").textContent =
            ai.requests ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-tokens").textContent =
            (ai.tokens ?? 0) + " tokens";

        document.getElementById("kpi-active-workflows").textContent =
            a.active_workflows ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-total-workflows").textContent =
            (a.total_workflows ?? 0) + " total";

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("KPI dashboard error:", error);
    }
}

document.getElementById("kpi-period").addEventListener(
    "change",
    function () {
        loadKPI(this.value);
    }
);

loadKPI("30d");
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSCommandCenter() {
    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions");

    try {
        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-loading">Analyzing business signals...</div>';

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_intelligence') }}",
            {
                method: "GET",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(
                data.message || data.error || "BOS request failed"
            );
        }

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            `${data.health_score}/100`;

        document.getElementById("bos-health-fill").style.width =
            `${data.health_score}%`;

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business intelligence is ready.";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-high").textContent =
            counts.high ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-sales").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const priorityActions =
            data.priority_actions || [];

        if (!priorityActions.length) {
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-empty">' +
                '✓ No priority actions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = priorityActions.map(item => {
            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${priority}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.title || "Business action")}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.message || "")}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(item.type || "signal")}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join("");

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value) {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent = String(value);
    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSCommandCenter
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSExecutiveCenter(){

    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions-list");

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_actions') }}",
            {
                method:"GET",
                headers:{
                    "Accept":"application/json"
                },
                credentials:"same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(!response.ok || !data.success){
            throw new Error(
                data.message || "BOS intelligence unavailable"
            );
        }

        const score = Number(data.health_score || 0);

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            Math.round(score);

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business operations are stable.";

        document.getElementById("bos-health-label").textContent =
            score >= 80 ? "Healthy" :
            score >= 60 ? "Needs attention" :
            "Critical";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-sales-count").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support-count").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation-count").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const items = Array.isArray(data.actions)
            ? data.actions
            : [];

        document.getElementById("bos-action-count").textContent =
            items.length;

        if(!items.length){
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-loading">' +
                'No priority actions detected. Operations look stable.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = items.map(function(item){

            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${escapeBOSHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.title || "Business action"
                            )}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.message || ""
                            )}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(
                            item.type || "signal"
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSExecutiveCenter
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSDecisions(){

    const container =
        document.getElementById("bos-decisions-list");

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_decisions') }}",
            {
                method:"GET",
                headers:{
                    "Accept":"application/json"
                },
                credentials:"same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(!response.ok || !data.success){
            throw new Error(
                data.message || "Decision intelligence unavailable"
            );
        }

        const decisions =
            Array.isArray(data.decisions)
                ? data.decisions
                : [];

        if(!decisions.length){

            container.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-decision-empty">' +
                'No strategic decisions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = decisions.map(function(decision){

            const priority =
                String(
                    decision.priority || "low"
                ).toLowerCase();

            return `
                <article class="bos-decision">

                    <div class="bos-decision-marker ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-decision-body">

                        <div class="bos-decision-top">
                            <strong>
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                    decision.title ||
                                    "Business decision"
                                )}
                            </strong>

                            <span class="bos-decision-priority">
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(priority)}
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="bos-decision-reason">
                            ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                decision.reason || ""
                            )}
                        </div>

                        <div class="bos-decision-action">

                            <span>
                                Recommended move
                            </span>

                            <p>
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                    decision.recommended_action ||
                                    "Review this decision."
                                )}
                            </p>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </article>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error(
            "Kemet BOS Decision Intelligence:",
            error
        );

        container.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-decision-error">' +
            'Decision intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSDecisionHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSDecisions
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadKPI(period) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials:"same-origin"}
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(data.message || data.error || "KPI request failed");
        }

        const k = data.data;
        const a = k.automation || {};
        const sp = k.support || {};
        const sa = k.sales || {};
        const r = k.revenue || {};
        const ai = k.ai || {};

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-success").textContent =
            (a.success_rate ?? 0) + "%";

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-executions").textContent =
            (a.total_executions ?? 0) + " executions";

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-total").textContent =
            sp.tickets_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-open").textContent =
            (sp.tickets_open ?? 0) + " open";

        document.getElementById("kpi-revenue").textContent =
            Number(r.paid_amount ?? 0).toFixed(2);

        document.getElementById("kpi-payments-paid").textContent =
            (r.payments_paid ?? 0) + " paid";

        document.getElementById("kpi-leads").textContent =
            sa.leads_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-converted-leads").textContent =
            ((sa.leads_by_status || {}).converted ?? 0) + " converted";

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-requests").textContent =
            ai.requests ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-tokens").textContent =
            (ai.tokens ?? 0) + " tokens";

        document.getElementById("kpi-active-workflows").textContent =
            a.active_workflows ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-total-workflows").textContent =
            (a.total_workflows ?? 0) + " total";

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("KPI dashboard error:", error);
    }
}

document.getElementById("kpi-period").addEventListener(
    "change",
    function () {
        loadKPI(this.value);
    }
);

loadKPI("30d");
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSCommandCenter() {
    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions");

    try {
        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-loading">Analyzing business signals...</div>';

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_intelligence') }}",
            {
                method: "GET",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(
                data.message || data.error || "BOS request failed"
            );
        }

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            `${data.health_score}/100`;

        document.getElementById("bos-health-fill").style.width =
            `${data.health_score}%`;

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business intelligence is ready.";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-high").textContent =
            counts.high ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-sales").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const priorityActions =
            data.priority_actions || [];

        if (!priorityActions.length) {
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-empty">' +
                '✓ No priority actions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = priorityActions.map(item => {
            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${priority}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.title || "Business action")}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(item.message || "")}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(item.type || "signal")}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join("");

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value) {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent = String(value);
    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSCommandCenter
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadBOSExecutiveCenter(){

    const actions = document.getElementById("bos-actions-list");

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_actions') }}",
            {
                method:"GET",
                headers:{
                    "Accept":"application/json"
                },
                credentials:"same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(!response.ok || !data.success){
            throw new Error(
                data.message || "BOS intelligence unavailable"
            );
        }

        const score = Number(data.health_score || 0);

        document.getElementById("bos-health-score").textContent =
            Math.round(score);

        document.getElementById("bos-summary").textContent =
            data.summary || "Business operations are stable.";

        document.getElementById("bos-health-label").textContent =
            score >= 80 ? "Healthy" :
            score >= 60 ? "Needs attention" :
            "Critical";

        const counts = data.counts || {};

        document.getElementById("bos-sales-count").textContent =
            counts.sales ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-support-count").textContent =
            counts.support ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("bos-automation-count").textContent =
            counts.automation ?? 0;

        const items = Array.isArray(data.actions)
            ? data.actions
            : [];

        document.getElementById("bos-action-count").textContent =
            items.length;

        if(!items.length){
            actions.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-loading">' +
                'No priority actions detected. Operations look stable.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        actions.innerHTML = items.map(function(item){

            const priority =
                String(item.priority || "low").toLowerCase();

            return `
                <div class="bos-action">
                    <div class="bos-priority ${escapeBOSHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-action-content">
                        <strong>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.title || "Business action"
                            )}
                        </strong>

                        <small>
                            ${escapeBOSHtml(
                                item.message || ""
                            )}
                        </small>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bos-action-type">
                        ${escapeBOSHtml(
                            item.type || "signal"
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error("Kemet BOS:", error);

        actions.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-error">' +
            'Business intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSExecutiveCenter
);
</script>
