<script>
async function loadBOSDecisions(){

    const container =
        document.getElementById("bos-decisions-list");

    try{

        const response = await fetch(
            "{{ url_for('dashboard.bos_decisions') }}",
            {
                method:"GET",
                headers:{
                    "Accept":"application/json"
                },
                credentials:"same-origin"
            }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if(!response.ok || !data.success){
            throw new Error(
                data.message || "Decision intelligence unavailable"
            );
        }

        const decisions =
            Array.isArray(data.decisions)
                ? data.decisions
                : [];

        if(!decisions.length){

            container.innerHTML =
                '<div class="bos-decision-empty">' +
                'No strategic decisions require attention right now.' +
                '</div>';

            return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = decisions.map(function(decision){

            const priority =
                String(
                    decision.priority || "low"
                ).toLowerCase();

            return `
                <article class="bos-decision">

                    <div class="bos-decision-marker ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(priority)}"></div>

                    <div class="bos-decision-body">

                        <div class="bos-decision-top">
                            <strong>
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                    decision.title ||
                                    "Business decision"
                                )}
                            </strong>

                            <span class="bos-decision-priority">
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(priority)}
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="bos-decision-reason">
                            ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                decision.reason || ""
                            )}
                        </div>

                        <div class="bos-decision-action">

                            <span>
                                Recommended move
                            </span>

                            <p>
                                ${escapeBOSDecisionHtml(
                                    decision.recommended_action ||
                                    "Review this decision."
                                )}
                            </p>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </article>
            `;

        }).join("");

    }catch(error){

        console.error(
            "Kemet BOS Decision Intelligence:",
            error
        );

        container.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bos-decision-error">' +
            'Decision intelligence could not be loaded.' +
            '</div>';
    }
}

function escapeBOSDecisionHtml(value){

    const div = document.createElement("div");

    div.textContent = String(value);

    return div.innerHTML;
}

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    loadBOSDecisions
);
</script>

<script>
async function loadKPI(period) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials:"same-origin"}
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
            throw new Error(data.message || data.error || "KPI request failed");
        }

        const k = data.data;
        const a = k.automation || {};
        const sp = k.support || {};
        const sa = k.sales || {};
        const r = k.revenue || {};
        const ai = k.ai || {};

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-success").textContent =
            (a.success_rate ?? 0) + "%";

        document.getElementById("kpi-automation-executions").textContent =
            (a.total_executions ?? 0) + " executions";

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-total").textContent =
            sp.tickets_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-tickets-open").textContent =
            (sp.tickets_open ?? 0) + " open";

        document.getElementById("kpi-revenue").textContent =
            Number(r.paid_amount ?? 0).toFixed(2);

        document.getElementById("kpi-payments-paid").textContent =
            (r.payments_paid ?? 0) + " paid";

        document.getElementById("kpi-leads").textContent =
            sa.leads_total ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-converted-leads").textContent =
            ((sa.leads_by_status || {}).converted ?? 0) + " converted";

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-requests").textContent =
            ai.requests ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-ai-tokens").textContent =
            (ai.tokens ?? 0) + " tokens";

        document.getElementById("kpi-active-workflows").textContent =
            a.active_workflows ?? 0;

        document.getElementById("kpi-total-workflows").textContent =
            (a.total_workflows ?? 0) + " total";

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("KPI dashboard error:", error);
    }
}

document.getElementById("kpi-period").addEventListener(
    "change",
    function () {
        loadKPI(this.value);
    }
);

loadKPI("30d");
</script>
<!-- dashboard-shell-end -->

<script>

const csrfToken = document
.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]')
.content;


function addMessage(text,type){

    const box=document.getElementById("messages");

    const div=document.createElement("div");

    div.className="message "+type;

    div.innerText=text;

    box.appendChild(div);

    box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight;
}


let currentConversationId = null;

async function sendMessage(){

    const input = document.getElementById("message");
    const text = input.value.trim();

    if(!text){
        return;
    }

    addMessage(text, "user");
    input.value = "";

    try{
        const response = await fetch("/api/chat", {
            method: "POST",
            credentials: "same-origin",
            headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "X-CSRFToken": csrfToken
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                message: text,
                conversation_id: currentConversationId
            })
        });

        console.log("CHAT STATUS:", response.status);

        const raw = await response.text();
        console.log("CHAT RESPONSE:", raw);

        let data;
        try {
            data = JSON.parse(raw);
        } catch(e) {
            if(response.status === 401 || response.status === 302 || raw.includes("/login")) {
                addMessage("انتهت جلسة تسجيل الدخول. أعد تسجيل الدخول ثم حاول مرة أخرى.", "ai");
            } else {
                addMessage("Server error: HTTP " + response.status, "ai");
            }
            return;
        }

        if(!response.ok){
            addMessage(
                data.error || data.message || ("HTTP " + response.status),
                "ai"
            );
            return;
        }

        if(data.reply){
            addMessage(data.reply, "ai");

            // حفظ رقم المحادثة
            if(data.conversation_id){
                currentConversationId = data.conversation_id;
            }
        }else{
            addMessage("حدث خطأ في الرد", "ai");
        }

    }catch(error){
        console.log(error);
        addMessage("Connection error", "ai");
    }
}



function toggleTheme(){

    document.body.classList.toggle("light");

    localStorage.setItem(
        "kemet_theme",
        document.body.classList.contains("light")
    );

}



if(localStorage.getItem("kemet_theme")==="true"){

    document.body.classList.add("light");

}



function startVoiceInput(){

const SpeechRecognition =
window.SpeechRecognition ||
window.webkitSpeechRecognition;


if(!SpeechRecognition){

alert("Voice not supported");

return;

}


const recognition=new SpeechRecognition();


recognition.lang="ar-EG";

recognition.start();


recognition.onresult=function(event){

const text =
event.results[0][0].transcript;


document.getElementById("message").value=text;


sendMessage();

};


}




document.getElementById("fileInput")?.addEventListener(
"change",
uploadFile
);


async function uploadFile(){

const file =
document.getElementById("fileInput").files[0];

if(!file){
return;
}

let formData = new FormData();

formData.append("file", file);


const response = await fetch("/upload",{
method:"POST",
body:formData
});


const data = await response.json();


if(data.success){

addMessage(
"تم رفع الملف: " + data.filename,
"ai"
);

}else{

addMessage(
"فشل رفع الملف",
"ai"
);

}

}

function toggleSidebar(){
let side=document.querySelector(".sidebar");
side.classList.toggle("open");
}
</script>

<script>

const csrfToken = document
.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]')
.content;


function addMessage(text,type){

    const box=document.getElementById("messages");

    const div=document.createElement("div");

    div.className="message "+type;

    div.innerText=text;

    box.appendChild(div);

    box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight;
}


let currentConversationId = null;

async function sendMessage(){

    const input = document.getElementById("message");
    const text = input.value.trim();

    if(!text){
        return;
    }

    addMessage(text, "user");
    input.value = "";

    try{
        const response = await fetch("/api/chat", {
            method: "POST",
            credentials: "same-origin",
            headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "X-CSRFToken": csrfToken
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                message: text,
                conversation_id: currentConversationId
            })
        });

        console.log("CHAT STATUS:", response.status);

        const raw = await response.text();
        console.log("CHAT RESPONSE:", raw);

        let data;
        try {
            data = JSON.parse(raw);
        } catch(e) {
            if(response.status === 401 || response.status === 302 || raw.includes("/login")) {
                addMessage("انتهت جلسة تسجيل الدخول. أعد تسجيل الدخول ثم حاول مرة أخرى.", "ai");
            } else {
                addMessage("Server error: HTTP " + response.status, "ai");
            }
            return;
        }

        if(!response.ok){
            addMessage(
                data.error || data.message || ("HTTP " + response.status),
                "ai"
            );
            return;
        }

        if(data.reply){
            addMessage(data.reply, "ai");

            // حفظ رقم المحادثة
            if(data.conversation_id){
                currentConversationId = data.conversation_id;
            }
        }else{
            addMessage("حدث خطأ في الرد", "ai");
        }

    }catch(error){
        console.log(error);
        addMessage("Connection error", "ai");
    }
}



function toggleTheme(){

    document.body.classList.toggle("light");

    localStorage.setItem(
        "kemet_theme",
        document.body.classList.contains("light")
    );

}



if(localStorage.getItem("kemet_theme")==="true"){

    document.body.classList.add("light");

}



function startVoiceInput(){

const SpeechRecognition =
window.SpeechRecognition ||
window.webkitSpeechRecognition;


if(!SpeechRecognition){

alert("Voice not supported");

return;

}


const recognition=new SpeechRecognition();


recognition.lang="ar-EG";

recognition.start();


recognition.onresult=function(event){

const text =
event.results[0][0].transcript;


document.getElementById("message").value=text;


sendMessage();

};


}




document.getElementById("fileInput")?.addEventListener(
"change",
uploadFile
);


async function uploadFile(){

const file =
document.getElementById("fileInput").files[0];

if(!file){
return;
}

let formData = new FormData();

formData.append("file", file);


const response = await fetch("/upload",{
method:"POST",
body:formData
});


const data = await response.json();


if(data.success){

addMessage(
"تم رفع الملف: " + data.filename,
"ai"
);

}else{

addMessage(
"فشل رفع الملف",
"ai"
);

}

}

function toggleSidebar(){
let side=document.querySelector(".sidebar");
side.classList.toggle("open");
}
</script>


</body>

</html>

<script>

const csrfToken = document
.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]')
.content;


function addMessage(text,type){

    const box=document.getElementById("messages");

    const div=document.createElement("div");

    div.className="message "+type;

    div.innerText=text;

    box.appendChild(div);

    box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight;
}


let currentConversationId = null;

async function sendMessage(){

    const input = document.getElementById("message");
    const text = input.value.trim();

    if(!text){
        return;
    }

    addMessage(text, "user");
    input.value = "";

    try{
        const response = await fetch("/api/chat", {
            method: "POST",
            credentials: "same-origin",
            headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "X-CSRFToken": csrfToken
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                message: text,
                conversation_id: currentConversationId
            })
        });

        console.log("CHAT STATUS:", response.status);

        const raw = await response.text();
        console.log("CHAT RESPONSE:", raw);

        let data;
        try {
            data = JSON.parse(raw);
        } catch(e) {
            if(response.status === 401 || response.status === 302 || raw.includes("/login")) {
                addMessage("انتهت جلسة تسجيل الدخول. أعد تسجيل الدخول ثم حاول مرة أخرى.", "ai");
            } else {
                addMessage("Server error: HTTP " + response.status, "ai");
            }
            return;
        }

        if(!response.ok){
            addMessage(
                data.error || data.message || ("HTTP " + response.status),
                "ai"
            );
            return;
        }

        if(data.reply){
            addMessage(data.reply, "ai");

            // حفظ رقم المحادثة
            if(data.conversation_id){
                currentConversationId = data.conversation_id;
            }
        }else{
            addMessage("حدث خطأ في الرد", "ai");
        }

    }catch(error){
        console.log(error);
        addMessage("Connection error", "ai");
    }
}



function toggleTheme(){

    document.body.classList.toggle("light");

    localStorage.setItem(
        "kemet_theme",
        document.body.classList.contains("light")
    );

}



if(localStorage.getItem("kemet_theme")==="true"){

    document.body.classList.add("light");

}



function startVoiceInput(){

const SpeechRecognition =
window.SpeechRecognition ||
window.webkitSpeechRecognition;


if(!SpeechRecognition){

alert("Voice not supported");

return;

}


const recognition=new SpeechRecognition();


recognition.lang="ar-EG";

recognition.start();


recognition.onresult=function(event){

const text =
event.results[0][0].transcript;


document.getElementById("message").value=text;


sendMessage();

};


}




document.getElementById("fileInput")?.addEventListener(
"change",
uploadFile
);


async function uploadFile(){

const file =
document.getElementById("fileInput").files[0];

if(!file){
return;
}

let formData = new FormData();

formData.append("file", file);


const response = await fetch("/upload",{
method:"POST",
body:formData
});


const data = await response.json();


if(data.success){

addMessage(
"تم رفع الملف: " + data.filename,
"ai"
);

}else{

addMessage(
"فشل رفع الملف",
"ai"
);

}

}

function toggleSidebar(){
let side=document.querySelector(".sidebar");
side.classList.toggle("open");
}
</script>


</body>

</html>

        console.log("CHAT STATUS:", response.status);

        const raw = await response.text();
        console.log("CHAT RESPONSE:", raw);

        let data;
        try {
            data = JSON.parse(raw);
        } catch(e) {
            if(response.status === 401 || response.status === 302 || raw.includes("/login")) {
                addMessage("انتهت جلسة تسجيل الدخول. أعد تسجيل الدخول ثم حاول مرة أخرى.", "ai");
            } else {
                addMessage("Server error: HTTP " + response.status, "ai");
            }
            return;
        }

        if(!response.ok){
            addMessage(
                data.error || data.message || ("HTTP " + response.status),
                "ai"
            );
            return;
        }

        if(data.reply){
            addMessage(data.reply, "ai");

            // حفظ رقم المحادثة
            if(data.conversation_id){
                currentConversationId = data.conversation_id;
            }
        }else{
            addMessage("حدث خطأ في الرد", "ai");
        }

    }catch(error){
        console.log(error);
        addMessage("Connection error", "ai");
    }
}



function toggleTheme(){

    document.body.classList.toggle("light");

    localStorage.setItem(
        "kemet_theme",
        document.body.classList.contains("light")
    );

}



if(localStorage.getItem("kemet_theme")==="true"){

    document.body.classList.add("light");

}



function startVoiceInput(){

const SpeechRecognition =
window.SpeechRecognition ||
window.webkitSpeechRecognition;


if(!SpeechRecognition){

alert("Voice not supported");

return;

}


const recognition=new SpeechRecognition();


recognition.lang="ar-EG";

recognition.start();


recognition.onresult=function(event){

const text =
event.results[0][0].transcript;


document.getElementById("message").value=text;


sendMessage();

};


}




document.getElementById("fileInput")?.addEventListener(
"change",
uploadFile
);


async function uploadFile(){

const file =
document.getElementById("fileInput").files[0];

if(!file){
return;
}

let formData = new FormData();

formData.append("file", file);


const response = await fetch("/upload",{
method:"POST",
body:formData
});


const data = await response.json();


if(data.success){

addMessage(
"تم رفع الملف: " + data.filename,
"ai"
);

}else{

addMessage(
"فشل رفع الملف",
"ai"
);

}

}

function toggleSidebar(){
let side=document.querySelector(".sidebar");
side.classList.toggle("open");
}
</script>


</body>

let conversationId = {{ conversation_id|tojson }};

const input = document.querySelector(".input-box input");
const button = document.querySelector(".input-box button");
const messages = document.querySelector(".messages");

button.onclick = async function(){

    const message = input.value.trim();

    if(!message){
        return;
    }

    messages.innerHTML += "<p><b>You:</b> " + message + "</p>";
    input.value = "";

    const response = await fetch("/api/chat", {
        method:"POST",
        headers:{
            "Content-Type":"application/json",
            "X-CSRFToken": document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').content
        },
        body:JSON.stringify({
            message:message,
            conversation_id:conversationId
        })
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
    const text = await response.text();
    console.log("Status:", response.status);
    console.log(text);
    alert("HTTP " + response.status);
    return;
}

const data = await response.json();

    conversationId = data.conversation_id;

    messages.innerHTML += "<p><b>Kemet AI:</b> " + data.reply + "</p>";
};
</script>

<script>
(function () {
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

    function money(value) {
        return "$" + Number(value || 0).toLocaleString(
            undefined,
            {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2}
        );
    }

    function number(value) {
        return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString();
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value ?? "")
            .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
            .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
            .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
            .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
            .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
    }

    function getCSRFToken() {
        const meta = document.querySelector(
            'meta[name="csrf-token"]'
        );

        return meta ? meta.getAttribute("content") : "";
    }

    async function loadBOSEnterpriseControlCenter() {
        const endpoints = {
            control: "/dashboard/api/bos/control-center",
            summary: "/dashboard/api/bos/decision-summary",
            snapshot: "/dashboard/api/bos/executive-snapshot",
            governance: "/dashboard/api/bos/governance",
            entitlement: "/dashboard/api/entitlement"
        };

        async function getJSON(url) {
            const response = await fetch(url, {
                headers: {"Accept": "application/json"}
            });

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(url + " returned HTTP " + response.status);
            }

            return await response.json();
        }

        try {
            const [
                control,
                summary,
                snapshot,
                governance,
                entitlement
            ] = await Promise.all([
                getJSON(endpoints.control),
                getJSON(endpoints.summary),
                getJSON(endpoints.snapshot),
                getJSON(endpoints.governance),
                getJSON(endpoints.entitlement)
            ]);

            const counts = control.counts || {};
            const gov = control.governance || governance.governance || {};

            $("bos-health-score").textContent =
                Number(control.health_score || snapshot.health_score || 0).toFixed(0) + "%";

            $("bos-high-count").textContent =
                number(counts.high || 0);

            $("bos-medium-count").textContent =
                number(counts.medium || 0);

            $("bos-total-count").textContent =
                number(counts.total || summary.total || 0);

            $("bos-governance-mode").textContent =
                gov.mode || control.mode || "advisory";

            $("bos-approval-required").textContent =
                (gov.approval_required !== false && control.approval_required !== false)
                    ? "Yes"
                    : "No";

            $("bos-executive-focus").textContent =
                control.focus ||
                snapshot.focus ||
                summary.message ||
                "Executive intelligence available.";

            $("bos-safety-status").textContent =
                "Database mutation: " +
                (control.database_mutation ? "enabled" : "disabled") +
                " · External execution: " +
                (control.external_execution ? "enabled" : "disabled");

            const decisions =
                snapshot.top_decisions ||
                summary.decisions ||
                governance.decisions ||
                [];

            const container = $("bos-executive-decisions");

            if (!decisions.length) {
                container.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="cc-status">No strategic decisions currently require attention.</div>';
            } else {
                container.innerHTML = decisions.slice(0, 5).map(function (decision) {
                    const title = escapeHtml(
                        decision.title ||
                        decision.reason ||
                        "Business decision"
                    );

                    const priority = escapeHtml(
                        decision.priority || "low"
                    );

                    const reason = escapeHtml(
                        decision.reason || ""
                    );

                    const id = escapeHtml(
                        decision.id || ""
                    );

                    return `
                        <div class="cc-decision">
                            <div class="cc-decision-title">${title}</div>
                            <div class="cc-decision-meta">
                                Priority: ${priority}
                                ${reason ? " · " + reason : ""}
                            </div>
                            ${
                                id
                                ? `<button class="btn"
                                    style="margin-top:8px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:11px"
                                    onclick="window.open('/dashboard/api/bos/approval-preview/${id}', '_blank')">
                                    Review
                                </button>`
                                : ""
                            }
                        </div>
                    `;
                }).join("");
            }

            const plan =
                entitlement.plan ||
                entitlement.subscription ||
                entitlement.current_plan ||
                "—";

            const usage =
                entitlement.used ??
                entitlement.usage ??
                entitlement.usage_count;

            const remaining =
                entitlement.remaining ??
                entitlement.remaining_usage;

            $("bos-plan").textContent = String(plan);

            $("bos-usage").textContent =
                usage === undefined || usage === null
                    ? "—"
                    : number(usage);

            $("bos-remaining").textContent =
                remaining === undefined || remaining === null
                    ? "—"
                    : number(remaining);

        } catch (error) {
            console.error("BOS Executive Control Center:", error);

            $("bos-executive-focus").textContent =
                "Executive intelligence unavailable.";

            $("bos-executive-decisions").innerHTML =
                '<div class="cc-error">Unable to load BOS executive data.</div>';
        }
    }

    async function handleCCDecisionTransition(decisionId, transition) {
        if (!decisionId || !transition) {
            return;
        }

        const confirmed = window.confirm(
            "Apply decision transition: " + transition + "?"
        );

        if (!confirmed) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                "/dashboard/api/bos/decision-transition",
                {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/json",
                        "X-CSRFToken": getCSRFToken()
                    },
                    credentials: "same-origin",
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        decision_id: decisionId,
                        transition: transition
                    })
                }
            );

            const payload = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || payload.ok !== true) {
                throw new Error(
                    payload.message ||
                    payload.error ||
                    "Decision transition failed."
                );
            }

            await loadDecisions();

        } catch (error) {
            console.error(
                "BOS decision transition failed:",
                error
            );

            window.alert(
                error.message ||
                "Decision transition failed."
            );
        }
    }

    async function loadKPI(period) {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials: "same-origin"}
        );

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error("KPI HTTP " + response.status);
        }

        const payload = await response.json();

        if (!payload.success) {
            throw new Error(payload.message || payload.error || "KPI failed");
        }

        const data = payload.data || {};
        const revenue = data.revenue || {};
        const sales = data.sales || {};
        const support = data.support || {};
        const automation = data.automation || {};
        const ai = data.ai || {};

        const statuses = sales.leads_by_status || {};
        const won = Number(statuses.won || 0);

        const paid = Number(revenue.paid_amount || 0);
        const paymentsPaid = Number(revenue.payments_paid || 0);
        const leads = Number(sales.leads_total || 0);
        const tickets = Number(support.tickets_total || 0);
        const openTickets = Number(support.tickets_open || 0);
        const rate = Number(automation.success_rate || 0);

        $("cc-revenue").textContent = money(paid);
        $("cc-payments").textContent =
            number(paymentsPaid) + " paid payments";

        $("cc-leads").textContent = number(leads);
        $("cc-won").textContent = number(won) + " won leads";

        $("cc-tickets").textContent = number(tickets);
        $("cc-open").textContent =
            number(openTickets) + " open tickets";

        $("cc-success").textContent = rate.toFixed(2) + "%";
        $("cc-executions").textContent =
            number(automation.total_executions) + " executions";

        $("metric-revenue").textContent = money(paid);
        $("metric-subscriptions").textContent =
            number(revenue.subscriptions_active);
        $("metric-leads").textContent = number(leads);
        $("metric-open-tickets").textContent = number(openTickets);
        $("metric-ai").textContent = number(ai.requests);

        $("automation-rate").textContent =
            rate.toFixed(2) + "%";
        $("automation-progress").style.width =
            Math.min(Math.max(rate, 0), 100) + "%";

        $("automation-workflows").textContent =
            number(automation.total_workflows);
        $("automation-successful").textContent =
            number(automation.successful_executions);
        $("automation-failed").textContent =
            number(automation.failed_executions);

        $("support-total").textContent =
            number(tickets);
        $("support-open").textContent =
            number(support.tickets_open);
        $("support-pending").textContent =
            number(support.tickets_pending);
        $("support-closed").textContent =
            number(support.tickets_closed);
        $("support-ai").textContent =
            number(support.ai_replies);

        $("health-value").textContent =
            rate.toFixed(2) + "%";
        $("health-progress").style.width =
            Math.min(Math.max(rate, 0), 100) + "%";

        $("ai-requests").textContent =
            number(ai.requests);
        $("ai-tokens").textContent =
            number(ai.tokens);

        $("cc-period-label").textContent =
            period === "7d" ? "Last 7 days" :
            period === "90d" ? "Last 90 days" :
            "Last 30 days";
    }

    async function loadDecisions() {
        const box = $("bos-decisions");

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                "/dashboard/api/bos/decisions",
                {credentials: "same-origin"}
            );

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error("BOS HTTP " + response.status);
            }

            const payload = await response.json();

            let decisions = [];

            if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
                decisions = payload;
            } else if (Array.isArray(payload.decisions)) {
                decisions = payload.decisions;
            } else if (Array.isArray(payload.data)) {
                decisions = payload.data;
            }

            if (!decisions.length) {
                box.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="cc-status">No pending decisions.</div>';
                return;
            }

            box.innerHTML = decisions.slice(0, 5).map(function (item) {
                const title =
                    item.title ||
                    item.name ||
                    item.reason ||
                    item.action ||
                    "Business decision";

                const status =
                    item.status ||
                    item.state ||
                    "pending";

                const priority =
                    item.priority ||
                    "normal";

                const decisionId =
                    item.id ||
                    item.decision_id ||
                    item.decisionId;

                const reason =
                    item.reason ||
                    item.recommended_action ||
                    "";

                return `
                    <div class="cc-decision">
                        <div class="cc-decision-title">
                            ${escapeHtml(title)}
                        </div>

                        <div class="cc-decision-meta">
                            <span>${escapeHtml(status)}</span>
                            <span>${escapeHtml(priority)}</span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="cc-decision-reason">
                            ${escapeHtml(reason)}
                        </div>

                        ${
                            decisionId
                            ? `
                            <div class="cc-decision-actions">
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onclick="handleCCDecisionTransition(${Number(decisionId)}, 'approve')"
                                >
                                    Approve
                                </button>

                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onclick="handleCCDecisionTransition(${Number(decisionId)}, 'reject')"
                                >
                                    Reject
                                </button>

                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onclick="handleCCDecisionTransition(${Number(decisionId)}, 'snooze')"
                                >
                                    Snooze
                                </button>
                            </div>
                            `
                            : ""
                        }
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join("");

        } catch (error) {
            box.innerHTML =
                '<div class="cc-error">BOS data unavailable.</div>';
        }
    }

    async function refresh(period) {
        try {
            await loadKPI(period);

            $("cc-status").innerHTML =
                '<span class="dot"></span> Live business intelligence';
        } catch (error) {
            $("cc-status").innerHTML =
                '<span class="dot"></span> KPI data unavailable';
            console.error(error);
        }

        await loadDecisions();
    }

    document.querySelectorAll(".cc-period button").forEach(function (button) {
        button.addEventListener("click", function () {
            document.querySelectorAll(".cc-period button")
                .forEach(function (item) {
                    item.classList.remove("active");
                });

            button.classList.add("active");
            refresh(button.dataset.period);
        });
    });

    refresh("30d");

    setInterval(function () {
        const active =
            document.querySelector(".cc-period button.active");

        refresh(active ? active.dataset.period : "30d");
    }, 60000);
    loadBOSEnterpriseControlCenter();
</script>

<style>

    gap:14px;

<script>
(function () {
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

    function money(value) {
        return "$" + Number(value || 0).toLocaleString(
            undefined,
            {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2}
        );
    }

    function number(value) {
        return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString();
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value ?? "")
            .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
            .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
            .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
            .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
            .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
    }

    function getCSRFToken() {
        const meta = document.querySelector(
            'meta[name="csrf-token"]'
        );

        return meta ? meta.getAttribute("content") : "";
    }

    async function handleCCDecisionTransition(decisionId, transition) {
        if (!decisionId || !transition) {
            return;
        }

        const confirmed = window.confirm(
            "Apply decision transition: " + transition + "?"
        );

        if (!confirmed) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                "/dashboard/api/bos/decision-transition",
                {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/json",
                        "X-CSRFToken": getCSRFToken()
                    },
                    credentials: "same-origin",
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        decision_id: decisionId,
                        transition: transition
                    })
                }
            );

            const payload = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || payload.ok !== true) {
                throw new Error(
                    payload.message ||
                    payload.error ||
                    "Decision transition failed."
                );
            }

            await loadDecisions();

        } catch (error) {
            console.error(
                "BOS decision transition failed:",
                error
            );

            window.alert(
                error.message ||
                "Decision transition failed."
            );
        }
    }

    async function loadKPI(period) {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials: "same-origin"}
        );

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error("KPI HTTP " + response.status);
        }

        const payload = await response.json();

        if (!payload.success) {
            throw new Error(payload.message || payload.error || "KPI failed");
        }

        const data = payload.data || {};
        const revenue = data.revenue || {};
        const sales = data.sales || {};
        const support = data.support || {};
        const automation = data.automation || {};
        const ai = data.ai || {};

        const statuses = sales.leads_by_status || {};
        const won = Number(statuses.won || 0);

        const paid = Number(revenue.paid_amount || 0);
        const paymentsPaid = Number(revenue.payments_paid || 0);
        const leads = Number(sales.leads_total || 0);
        const tickets = Number(support.tickets_total || 0);
        const openTickets = Number(support.tickets_open || 0);
        const rate = Number(automation.success_rate || 0);

        $("cc-revenue").textContent = money(paid);
        $("cc-payments").textContent =
            number(paymentsPaid) + " paid payments";

        $("cc-leads").textContent = number(leads);
        $("cc-won").textContent = number(won) + " won leads";

        $("cc-tickets").textContent = number(tickets);
        $("cc-open").textContent =
            number(openTickets) + " open tickets";

        $("cc-success").textContent = rate.toFixed(2) + "%";
        $("cc-executions").textContent =
            number(automation.total_executions) + " executions";

        $("metric-revenue").textContent = money(paid);
        $("metric-subscriptions").textContent =
            number(revenue.subscriptions_active);
        $("metric-leads").textContent = number(leads);
        $("metric-open-tickets").textContent = number(openTickets);
        $("metric-ai").textContent = number(ai.requests);

        $("automation-rate").textContent =
            rate.toFixed(2) + "%";
        $("automation-progress").style.width =
            Math.min(Math.max(rate, 0), 100) + "%";

        $("automation-workflows").textContent =
            number(automation.total_workflows);
        $("automation-successful").textContent =
            number(automation.successful_executions);
        $("automation-failed").textContent =
            number(automation.failed_executions);

        $("support-total").textContent =
            number(tickets);
        $("support-open").textContent =
            number(support.tickets_open);
        $("support-pending").textContent =
            number(support.tickets_pending);
        $("support-closed").textContent =
            number(support.tickets_closed);
        $("support-ai").textContent =
            number(support.ai_replies);

        $("health-value").textContent =
            rate.toFixed(2) + "%";
        $("health-progress").style.width =
            Math.min(Math.max(rate, 0), 100) + "%";

        $("ai-requests").textContent =
            number(ai.requests);
        $("ai-tokens").textContent =
            number(ai.tokens);

        $("cc-period-label").textContent =
            period === "7d" ? "Last 7 days" :
            period === "90d" ? "Last 90 days" :
            "Last 30 days";
    }

    async function loadDecisions() {
        const box = $("bos-decisions");

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                "/dashboard/api/bos/decisions",
                {credentials: "same-origin"}
            );

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error("BOS HTTP " + response.status);
            }

            const payload = await response.json();

            let decisions = [];

            if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
                decisions = payload;
            } else if (Array.isArray(payload.decisions)) {
                decisions = payload.decisions;
            } else if (Array.isArray(payload.data)) {
                decisions = payload.data;
            }

            if (!decisions.length) {
                box.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="cc-status">No pending decisions.</div>';
                return;
            }

            box.innerHTML = decisions.slice(0, 5).map(function (item) {
                const title =
                    item.title ||
                    item.name ||
                    item.reason ||
                    item.action ||
                    "Business decision";

                const status =
                    item.status ||
                    item.state ||
                    "pending";

                const priority =
                    item.priority ||
                    "normal";

                const decisionId =
                    item.id ||
                    item.decision_id ||
                    item.decisionId;

                const reason =
                    item.reason ||
                    item.recommended_action ||
                    "";

                return `
                    <div class="cc-decision">
                        <div class="cc-decision-title">
                            ${escapeHtml(title)}
                        </div>

                        <div class="cc-decision-meta">
                            <span>${escapeHtml(status)}</span>
                            <span>${escapeHtml(priority)}</span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="cc-decision-reason">
                            ${escapeHtml(reason)}
                        </div>

                        ${
                            decisionId
                            ? `
                            <div class="cc-decision-actions">
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onclick="handleCCDecisionTransition(${Number(decisionId)}, 'approve')"
                                >
                                    Approve
                                </button>

                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onclick="handleCCDecisionTransition(${Number(decisionId)}, 'reject')"
                                >
                                    Reject
                                </button>

                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onclick="handleCCDecisionTransition(${Number(decisionId)}, 'snooze')"
                                >
                                    Snooze
                                </button>
                            </div>
                            `
                            : ""
                        }
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join("");

        } catch (error) {
            box.innerHTML =
                '<div class="cc-error">BOS data unavailable.</div>';
        }
    }

    async function refresh(period) {
        try {
            await loadKPI(period);

            $("cc-status").innerHTML =
                '<span class="dot"></span> Live business intelligence';
        } catch (error) {
            $("cc-status").innerHTML =
                '<span class="dot"></span> KPI data unavailable';
            console.error(error);
        }

        await loadDecisions();
    }

    document.querySelectorAll(".cc-period button").forEach(function (button) {
        button.addEventListener("click", function () {
            document.querySelectorAll(".cc-period button")
                .forEach(function (item) {
                    item.classList.remove("active");
                });

            button.classList.add("active");
            refresh(button.dataset.period);
        });
    });

    refresh("30d");

    setInterval(function () {
        const active =
            document.querySelector(".cc-period button.active");

        refresh(active ? active.dataset.period : "30d");
    }, 60000);
})();
</script>

<script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='js/kemet-v2.js') }}"></script>
<script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='js/kemet-v3.js') }}"></script>

{% endblock %}

<script>
(function () {
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

    function money(value) {
        return "$" + Number(value || 0).toLocaleString(
            undefined,
            {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2}
        );
    }

    function number(value) {
        return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString();
    }

    async function loadKPI(period) {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials: "same-origin"}
        );

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error("KPI HTTP " + response.status);
        }

        const payload = await response.json();

        if (!payload.success) {
            throw new Error(payload.message || payload.error || "KPI failed");
        }

        const data = payload.data || {};
        const revenue = data.revenue || {};
        const sales = data.sales || {};
        const support = data.support || {};
        const automation = data.automation || {};
        const ai = data.ai || {};

        const statuses = sales.leads_by_status || {};
        const won = Number(statuses.won || 0);

        const paid = Number(revenue.paid_amount || 0);
        const paymentsPaid = Number(revenue.payments_paid || 0);
        const leads = Number(sales.leads_total || 0);
        const tickets = Number(support.tickets_total || 0);
        const openTickets = Number(support.tickets_open || 0);
        const rate = Number(automation.success_rate || 0);

        $("cc-revenue").textContent = money(paid);
        $("cc-payments").textContent =
            number(paymentsPaid) + " paid payments";

        $("cc-leads").textContent = number(leads);
        $("cc-won").textContent = number(won) + " won leads";

        $("cc-tickets").textContent = number(tickets);
        $("cc-open").textContent =
            number(openTickets) + " open tickets";

        $("cc-success").textContent = rate.toFixed(2) + "%";
        $("cc-executions").textContent =
            number(automation.total_executions) + " executions";

        $("metric-revenue").textContent = money(paid);
        $("metric-subscriptions").textContent =
            number(revenue.subscriptions_active);
        $("metric-leads").textContent = number(leads);
        $("metric-open-tickets").textContent = number(openTickets);
        $("metric-ai").textContent = number(ai.requests);

        $("automation-rate").textContent =
            rate.toFixed(2) + "%";
        $("automation-progress").style.width =
            Math.min(Math.max(rate, 0), 100) + "%";

        $("automation-workflows").textContent =
            number(automation.total_workflows);
        $("automation-successful").textContent =
            number(automation.successful_executions);
        $("automation-failed").textContent =
            number(automation.failed_executions);

        $("support-total").textContent =
            number(tickets);
        $("support-open").textContent =
            number(support.tickets_open);
        $("support-pending").textContent =
            number(support.tickets_pending);
        $("support-closed").textContent =
            number(support.tickets_closed);
        $("support-ai").textContent =
            number(support.ai_replies);

        $("health-value").textContent =
            rate.toFixed(2) + "%";
        $("health-progress").style.width =
            Math.min(Math.max(rate, 0), 100) + "%";

        $("ai-requests").textContent =
            number(ai.requests);
        $("ai-tokens").textContent =
            number(ai.tokens);

        $("cc-period-label").textContent =
            period === "7d" ? "Last 7 days" :
            period === "90d" ? "Last 90 days" :
            "Last 30 days";
    }

    async function loadDecisions() {
        const box = $("bos-decisions");

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                "/dashboard/api/bos/decisions",
                {credentials: "same-origin"}
            );

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error("BOS HTTP " + response.status);
            }

            const payload = await response.json();

            let decisions = [];

            if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
                decisions = payload;
            } else if (Array.isArray(payload.decisions)) {
                decisions = payload.decisions;
            } else if (Array.isArray(payload.data)) {
                decisions = payload.data;
            }

            if (!decisions.length) {
                box.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="cc-status">No pending decisions.</div>';
                return;
            }

            box.innerHTML = decisions.slice(0, 5).map(function (item) {
                const title =
                    item.title ||
                    item.name ||
                    item.reason ||
                    item.action ||
                    "Business decision";

                const status =
                    item.status ||
                    item.state ||
                    "pending";

                return `
                    <div class="cc-decision">
                        <div class="cc-decision-title">
                            ${String(title)}
                        </div>
                        <div class="cc-decision-meta">
                            ${String(status)}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join("");

        } catch (error) {
            box.innerHTML =
                '<div class="cc-error">BOS data unavailable.</div>';
        }
    }

    async function refresh(period) {
        try {
            await loadKPI(period);

            $("cc-status").innerHTML =
                '<span class="dot"></span> Live business intelligence';
        } catch (error) {
            $("cc-status").innerHTML =
                '<span class="dot"></span> KPI data unavailable';
            console.error(error);
        }

        await loadDecisions();
    }

    document.querySelectorAll(".cc-period button").forEach(function (button) {
        button.addEventListener("click", function () {
            document.querySelectorAll(".cc-period button")
                .forEach(function (item) {
                    item.classList.remove("active");
                });

            button.classList.add("active");
            refresh(button.dataset.period);
        });
    });

    refresh("30d");

    setInterval(function () {
        const active =
            document.querySelector(".cc-period button.active");

        refresh(active ? active.dataset.period : "30d");
    }, 60000);
})();
</script>

<script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='js/kemet-v2.js') }}"></script>
<script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='js/kemet-v3.js') }}"></script>

<script>
(function () {
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

    function money(value) {
        return "$" + Number(value || 0).toLocaleString(
            undefined,
            {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2}
        );
    }

    function number(value) {
        return Number(value || 0).toLocaleString();
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value ?? "")
            .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
            .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
            .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
            .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
            .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
    }

    function getCSRFToken() {
        const meta = document.querySelector(
            'meta[name="csrf-token"]'
        );

        return meta ? meta.getAttribute("content") : "";
    }

    async function handleCCDecisionTransition(decisionId, transition) {
        if (!decisionId || !transition) {
            return;
        }

        const confirmed = window.confirm(
            "Apply decision transition: " + transition + "?"
        );

        if (!confirmed) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                "/dashboard/api/bos/decision-transition",
                {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/json",
                        "X-CSRFToken": getCSRFToken()
                    },
                    credentials: "same-origin",
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        decision_id: decisionId,
                        transition: transition
                    })
                }
            );

            const payload = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok || payload.ok !== true) {
                throw new Error(
                    payload.message ||
                    payload.error ||
                    "Decision transition failed."
                );
            }

            await loadDecisions();

        } catch (error) {
            console.error(
                "BOS decision transition failed:",
                error
            );

            window.alert(
                error.message ||
                "Decision transition failed."
            );
        }
    }

    async function loadKPI(period) {
        const response = await fetch(
            "/dashboard/api/kpis?period=" + encodeURIComponent(period),
            {credentials: "same-origin"}
        );

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error("KPI HTTP " + response.status);
        }

        const payload = await response.json();

        if (!payload.success) {
            throw new Error(payload.message || payload.error || "KPI failed");
        }

        const data = payload.data || {};
        const revenue = data.revenue || {};
        const sales = data.sales || {};
        const support = data.support || {};
        const automation = data.automation || {};
        const ai = data.ai || {};

        const statuses = sales.leads_by_status || {};
        const won = Number(statuses.won || 0);

        const paid = Number(revenue.paid_amount || 0);
        const paymentsPaid = Number(revenue.payments_paid || 0);
        const leads = Number(sales.leads_total || 0);
        const tickets = Number(support.tickets_total || 0);
        const openTickets = Number(support.tickets_open || 0);
        const rate = Number(automation.success_rate || 0);

        $("cc-revenue").textContent = money(paid);
        $("cc-payments").textContent =
            number(paymentsPaid) + " paid payments";

        $("cc-leads").textContent = number(leads);
        $("cc-won").textContent = number(won) + " won leads";

        $("cc-tickets").textContent = number(tickets);
        $("cc-open").textContent =
            number(openTickets) + " open tickets";

        $("cc-success").textContent = rate.toFixed(2) + "%";
        $("cc-executions").textContent =
            number(automation.total_executions) + " executions";

        $("metric-revenue").textContent = money(paid);
        $("metric-subscriptions").textContent =
            number(revenue.subscriptions_active);
        $("metric-leads").textContent = number(leads);
        $("metric-open-tickets").textContent = number(openTickets);
        $("metric-ai").textContent = number(ai.requests);

        $("automation-rate").textContent =
            rate.toFixed(2) + "%";
        $("automation-progress").style.width =
            Math.min(Math.max(rate, 0), 100) + "%";

        $("automation-workflows").textContent =
            number(automation.total_workflows);
        $("automation-successful").textContent =
            number(automation.successful_executions);
        $("automation-failed").textContent =
            number(automation.failed_executions);

        $("support-total").textContent =
            number(tickets);
        $("support-open").textContent =
            number(support.tickets_open);
        $("support-pending").textContent =
            number(support.tickets_pending);
        $("support-closed").textContent =
            number(support.tickets_closed);
        $("support-ai").textContent =
            number(support.ai_replies);

        $("health-value").textContent =
            rate.toFixed(2) + "%";
        $("health-progress").style.width =
            Math.min(Math.max(rate, 0), 100) + "%";

        $("ai-requests").textContent =
            number(ai.requests);
        $("ai-tokens").textContent =
            number(ai.tokens);

        $("cc-period-label").textContent =
            period === "7d" ? "Last 7 days" :
            period === "90d" ? "Last 90 days" :
            "Last 30 days";
    }

    async function loadDecisions() {
        const box = $("bos-decisions");

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                "/dashboard/api/bos/decisions",
                {credentials: "same-origin"}
            );

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error("BOS HTTP " + response.status);
            }

            const payload = await response.json();

            let decisions = [];

            if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
                decisions = payload;
            } else if (Array.isArray(payload.decisions)) {
                decisions = payload.decisions;
            } else if (Array.isArray(payload.data)) {
                decisions = payload.data;
            }

            if (!decisions.length) {
                box.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="cc-status">No pending decisions.</div>';
                return;
            }

            box.innerHTML = decisions.slice(0, 5).map(function (item) {
                const title =
                    item.title ||
                    item.name ||
                    item.reason ||
                    item.action ||
                    "Business decision";

                const status =
                    item.status ||
                    item.state ||
                    "pending";

                const priority =
                    item.priority ||
                    "normal";

                const decisionId =
                    item.id ||
                    item.decision_id ||
                    item.decisionId;

                const reason =
                    item.reason ||
                    item.recommended_action ||
                    "";

                return `
                    <div class="cc-decision">
                        <div class="cc-decision-title">
                            ${escapeHtml(title)}
                        </div>

                        <div class="cc-decision-meta">
                            <span>${escapeHtml(status)}</span>
                            <span>${escapeHtml(priority)}</span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="cc-decision-reason">
                            ${escapeHtml(reason)}
                        </div>

                        ${
                            decisionId
                            ? `
                            <div class="cc-decision-actions">
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onclick="handleCCDecisionTransition(${Number(decisionId)}, 'approve')"
                                >
                                    Approve
                                </button>

                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onclick="handleCCDecisionTransition(${Number(decisionId)}, 'reject')"
                                >
                                    Reject
                                </button>

                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onclick="handleCCDecisionTransition(${Number(decisionId)}, 'snooze')"
                                >
                                    Snooze
                                </button>
                            </div>
                            `
                            : ""
                        }
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join("");

        } catch (error) {
            box.innerHTML =
                '<div class="cc-error">BOS data unavailable.</div>';
        }
    }

    async function refresh(period) {
        try {
            await loadKPI(period);

            $("cc-status").innerHTML =
                '<span class="dot"></span> Live business intelligence';
        } catch (error) {
            $("cc-status").innerHTML =
                '<span class="dot"></span> KPI data unavailable';
            console.error(error);
        }

        await loadDecisions();
    }

    document.querySelectorAll(".cc-period button").forEach(function (button) {
        button.addEventListener("click", function () {
            document.querySelectorAll(".cc-period button")
                .forEach(function (item) {
                    item.classList.remove("active");
                });

            button.classList.add("active");
            refresh(button.dataset.period);
        });
    });

    refresh("30d");

    setInterval(function () {
        const active =
            document.querySelector(".cc-period button.active");

        refresh(active ? active.dataset.period : "30d");
    }, 60000);
})();
</script>

<script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='js/kemet-v3.js') }}"></script>

{% endblock %}

try{

document.querySelector(".status").innerHTML=
'<span class="dot"></span> All systems operational';
}catch(e){
document.querySelector(".status").innerHTML=
'<span class="dot" style="background:#ff5d73"></span> System check failed';
}
}

checkHealth();

}
}

}

<script>
function toggleMobileSidebar(){
    const sidebar = document.querySelector('.unified-sidebar');
    const overlay = document.querySelector('.sidebar-overlay');

    if(!sidebar) return;

    sidebar.classList.toggle('mobile-open');
    overlay.classList.toggle('active');
}

function closeMobileSidebar(){
    const sidebar = document.querySelector('.unified-sidebar');
    const overlay = document.querySelector('.sidebar-overlay');

    if(!sidebar) return;

    sidebar.classList.remove('mobile-open');
    overlay.classList.remove('active');
}

document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    const link = e.target.closest('.unified-sidebar a');

    if(link && window.innerWidth <= 700){
        closeMobileSidebar();
    }
});
</script>

<script>
(function () {

    function initKemetMobileSidebar() {

        const btn = document.getElementById("kemetMobileMenuBtn");
        const overlay = document.getElementById("kemetMobileOverlay");

        if (!btn || !overlay) return;

        function openSidebar() {
            document.body.classList.add("kemet-mobile-sidebar-open");
            btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
            btn.innerHTML = "✕";
        }

        function closeSidebar() {
            document.body.classList.remove("kemet-mobile-sidebar-open");
            btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
            btn.innerHTML = "☰";
        }

        function toggleSidebar() {
            if (document.body.classList.contains("kemet-mobile-sidebar-open")) {
                closeSidebar();
            } else {
                openSidebar();
            }
        }

        btn.onclick = toggleSidebar;
        overlay.onclick = closeSidebar;

        document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
            if (e.key === "Escape") {
                closeSidebar();
            }
        });

        document.querySelectorAll(".unified-sidebar a").forEach(function (link) {
            link.addEventListener("click", function () {
                if (window.innerWidth <= 700) {
                    closeSidebar();
                }
            });
        });
    }

    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initKemetMobileSidebar);
    } else {
        initKemetMobileSidebar();
    }

})();
</script>

    if(!sidebar) return;

    sidebar.classList.toggle('mobile-open');

}

function closeMobileSidebar(){

    const overlay = document.querySelector('.sidebar-overlay');

    sidebar.classList.remove('mobile-open');
    overlay.classList.remove('active');
}

document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    const link = e.target.closest('.unified-sidebar a');

    if(link && window.innerWidth <= 700){
        closeMobileSidebar();
    }
});
</script>

<script>
(function () {

    function initKemetMobileSidebar() {

        const btn = document.getElementById("kemetMobileMenuBtn");
        const overlay = document.getElementById("kemetMobileOverlay");

        if (!btn || !overlay) return;

        function openSidebar() {
            document.body.classList.add("kemet-mobile-sidebar-open");
            btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
            btn.innerHTML = "✕";
        }

        function closeSidebar() {
            document.body.classList.remove("kemet-mobile-sidebar-open");
            btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
            btn.innerHTML = "☰";
        }

        function toggleSidebar() {
            if (document.body.classList.contains("kemet-mobile-sidebar-open")) {
                closeSidebar();
            } else {
                openSidebar();
            }
        }

        btn.onclick = toggleSidebar;
        overlay.onclick = closeSidebar;

        document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
            if (e.key === "Escape") {
                closeSidebar();
            }
        });

        document.querySelectorAll(".unified-sidebar a").forEach(function (link) {
            link.addEventListener("click", function () {
                if (window.innerWidth <= 700) {
                    closeSidebar();
                }
            });
        });
    }

    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initKemetMobileSidebar);
    } else {
        initKemetMobileSidebar();
    }

})();
</script>

<script>

function getAISuggestion(){

const box = document.getElementById("ai-suggestion-box");
const suggestion = document.getElementById("ai-suggestion");

box.style.display = "block";
suggestion.value = "جاري توليد اقتراح Kemet AI...";

fetch("/admin/support/ticket/{{ ticket.id }}/ai-suggest")

.then(response => {
    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("AI Suggest request failed");
    }
    return response.json();
})

.then(data => {

suggestion.value = data.suggestion || "لم يتم توليد اقتراح.";

})

.catch(error => {

console.log(error);

suggestion.value = "";
box.style.display = "none";

alert("حدث خطأ أثناء طلب اقتراح Kemet AI");

});

}


function useAISuggestion(){

document.getElementById("message-box").value =
document.getElementById("ai-suggestion").value;

document.getElementById("is-ai").value = "1";

}

</script>


</div>

.catch(error => {

console.log(error);

suggestion.value = "";
box.style.display = "none";

alert("حدث خطأ أثناء طلب اقتراح Kemet AI");

});

}


function useAISuggestion(){

document.getElementById("message-box").value =
document.getElementById("ai-suggestion").value;

document.getElementById("is-ai").value = "1";

}

</script>


</body>

</html>

const search = document.getElementById("ticketSearch");

if(search){
    search.addEventListener("input", function(){
        const q = this.value.toLowerCase().trim();

        document.querySelectorAll(".ticket").forEach(function(ticket){
            ticket.style.display =
                ticket.dataset.search.toLowerCase().includes(q)
                ? ""
                : "none";
        });
    });
}
